programme.title: 7ujuh (aka 7Seven: A Vengeful Suri)
programme.desc: 7個朋友踏上旅程,前往村長和女兒Suri經營的偏遠平房。他們舉行派對,並請求Suri擔任侍應。隨著派對逐漸失控,Suri不幸遭強暴。在自殺前,她對這7個人施下咒怨,使他們受到惡夢的纏擾。隨著這7人一個

programme.title: 凌晨三點鐘 - 營地
programme.desc: 一群漠視勸誡的年青人貿然闖進詭異森林露營作樂,入夜之後,他們內心的邪念驅使他們落入性與愛的關係陷阱,引來了森林裡一連串的靈異事件。黎明將至,他們當中有誰能逃生?

programme.title: 凌晨兩點半2
programme.desc: 依成和朋友到聚魂靈山探險,傳說山中埋著千年女屍,千年不滅之陰火,進去的人都逃不出來。凌晨兩點半,依成的朋友先後突然消失。在森林搜索期間,依成進入無限輪回的靈異空間,更恐怖的事情卻接踵而來…

programme.title: Evie
programme.desc: 當年輕的Evie在海灘上發現一條受詛咒的項鍊時,她並未察覺其中隱藏的邪惡力量。隨著項鍊的暗黑力量逐漸侵蝕她的意志,她無意中喚醒了恐怖的水魔,而這個水魔將威脅到她和她所愛之人的性命。

programme.title: Tear Us Apart
programme.desc: 幼女離奇失蹤後,悲痛的Drew與Helen在治療師安排下,前往偏遠林中小屋接受深度諮商。隨著孤立與壓抑逐漸侵蝕理智,療癒之旅化為噩夢。Helen飽受詭異幻象與異象困擾,逐漸分不清現實與幻覺,心智瀕臨崩

programme.title: 藍與黑
programme.desc: 抗日戰爭期間,少年孤女唐琪愛上青年張醒亞。家庭的壓力與戰爭的動盪令這對有情人飽受煎熬。直至唐琪不幸被強姦,不容於家庭, 而唯有走上夜總會歌女的不歸路

programme.title: 女校春色
programme.desc: 化學教師陳子風在一間保守的女校任教,與青梅竹馬的李海倫共事。陳在醫務所拾得棄嬰,後把棄嬰帶到學校照顧,卻被學生謠傳嬰孩乃陳與李之私生子。陳不但輕鬆面對,還將朝氣帶入校園,大受學生歡迎,李亦漸漸愛上陳。但保守派對陳之作風不滿,侍機剷除陳。

programme.title: 五毒
programme.desc: 蜈蚣功的鹿峰、蛇功的韋白、蠍子功的孫建、壁虎功的郭追、蛤蟆功的羅莽,各擅勝場,不同型格。電影風格奇特,一開始五毒門清理門戶,派出楊得將五個高手就地正法。同出師門,卻受師父追殺,有人說是喻他一手建立的張家班命运,張徹拍出殺戮的悲劇,沒有他慣常的大義浩然,卻有天地不容的毀滅性。

programme.title: 鳳還巢
programme.desc: 兵部侍郎程浦將次女雪娥許配予好友之子穆居易,庶室程夫人既憤且惱,對居易訛稱長女雪雁乃雪娥,催促二人早日成親。居易見雪雁貌醜而癡,嚇得留書出走。富豪朱煥然對雪娥心儀已久,趁此良機冒充居易,依期迎親……本片由李香君、金峰分飾男、女主角,配搭新鮮;而蔣光超與莊元庸一胖一瘦的諧趣演出,更令人笑破肚皮。

programme.title: 盜劍
programme.desc: 韓九重為奪削鐵如泥的青霜劍,誘殺師弟談鶴鳴;談鶴鳴的妻子耿六娘隱姓埋名在將軍府為傭,伺機奪劍報仇。將軍女兒嬌龍拜六娘為師,練成一身武藝,並與六娘師侄羅翼虎相戀。翼虎順嬌龍之意,深夜到親王府盜劍,然而寡不敵眾,失手被擒;嬌龍率眾營救,與韓九重等人展開連場激戰。

programme.title: 錯點鴛鴦
programme.desc: 任職推銷員的余小寶失戀後,遇上剛剛跟男友分手的富家女金金。二人同病相憐,很快便墜入愛河並閃電結婚,開展甜蜜的生活。可惜,此時金金卻發現自己懷上了前男友的骨肉

programme.title: 來如風
programme.desc: 明皇身染惡疾,駕崩在即,卻無子可繼帝位;皇侄世子傑本可繼位,惜不成器,難當大任。皇弟徽王想起明皇曾與東宮宮女生有子女各一,現時藏匿于東陽縣,遂命锦衣衛劉玄平尋找公主與王子的下落。劉玄平路上屢遭世子傑爪牙追殺,幸得俠士來如風相助

programme.title: 雙喜臨門
programme.desc: 朱國棟和李明珠本打算結婚,無奈雙方父母為多年死對頭,所以堅決反對婚事。於是二人不惜假裝自殺。有見及此雙方家長最終冰釋前嫌,答應二人成婚。此時,唱片公司宣佈會為出棟的歌曲版,最終可謂雙喜臨門。

programme.title: 陸小鳳之決戰前後
programme.desc: 兩大武林劍客葉孤城與西門吹雪將於紫禁城決鬥。陸小鳳忖度二人素末謀面,又無利益衝突,無須決鬥,猜想當中一定事有蹊蹺。於是,他決定和花滿樓前往京城調查清楚,卻發現當中隱藏的陰謀…

programme.title: 拜倒石榴裙
programme.desc: 年輕貌美的丁芝華為緩解家中困境,與弟弟策劃了一場珠寶騙局,並打算將贓物帶往新加坡變賣。飛行途中,她為躲避海關查緝,急中生智將鑽戒塞進鄰座乘客張志賢身上,卻在出關後失去他的蹤影。無奈之下,芝華只得施展一連串笨拙又滑稽的計謀,試圖奪回戒指。

programme.title: 插翅難飛
programme.desc: 鄧彪因為黑貨買賣失手,遂逼江湖人物高明供出從中陷害者,高明說出乃黑豹所為後,即被開槍殺死,鄧彪因此被判監禁十五年。他出獄後即找黑豹報仇,卻遇上勢力龐大的葛八爺幹擾;同時商琳為尋失蹤十五年的丈夫,欲找鄧彪查問黑豹下落,但兩人僅聽過黑豹其名,從未見其人,究竟黑豹是誰?

programme.title: 女巡按
programme.desc: 影后李菁的代表作,蕭湘反串文必正,傾慕官府小姐霍定金,賣身混入霍家,二人私定終身,必正被陷害入獄,定金設法營救

programme.title: 奪魂鈴
programme.desc: 故事描述,少年衛虎家遭左景龍、應天與楊剛所洗劫,父母幼弟被殺,姊衛芸被左劫走,頓時家破人亡。虎憤恨萬狀,放火燒毀家園,決心遠走天涯,找尋仇人報復;虎流浪各地,遇隱名大俠士,投拜為師,數年即習藝有成,遂往找仇人;虎抵雞兒鎮,遇弱女香香遭逼為娼,逐出手相助,擊退歹徒

programme.title: 碧血劍
programme.desc: 此片改編自金庸小說,描述一名將士逃亡時,發現一把寶劍、一本武林秘笈、一份藏寶圖和揭開暗藏於武林大俠屍首上之秘密信息後,隨即引發一場武林浩劫。

programme.title: 天蠶變
programme.desc: 武當弟子傅玉書殺害掌門後,嫁禍掌門之私生子雲飛揚,並接任掌門及下令要追殺他。雲飛揚誓要為父報仇,於是苦練天蠶功要打敗傅玉書。

programme.title: 天蠶變
programme.desc: 武當弟子傅玉書殺害掌門後,嫁禍掌門之私生子雲飛揚,並接任掌門及下令要追殺他。雲飛揚誓要為父報仇,於是苦練天蠶功要打敗傅玉書。

programme.title: 魔劍俠情
programme.desc: 狄龍扮演的小李悄然回到愛侶故園之旁隱居,遙對窗中倩影,而不相見,直至發生危機,小李才露面相告,並且挺身赴難。有不少高手為爭“武林排名”而找小李決鬥,小李又要對付惡勢力龐大的幫主谷峰,於是小李找尋舊友阿飛相助,但阿飛被陰險美女林仙兒所迷,簡直變成廢人,小李於是揭破這女人的假面目,並且設法使阿飛振作起來

programme.title: 老夫子奇趣錄
programme.desc: 電影承上集繼續笑料百出。這次,大蕃薯開了一家中醫診所,但傳統的中醫似乎不為時髦的香港社會接受。最後得靠好友老夫子相助,為他解決疑難!

programme.title: 荒江女俠
programme.desc: 鐵臂金剛方甯、方靜押送賑銀救濟黃河災民,途中受到盜寇的突襲,全家老少遭殺害,惟稚女方瑛琪為玄真道長救出,抱入深山撫養。瑛琪長成後,盡得玄真道長武功真傳。其時金兵圖大舉進犯中原,玄真道長授瑛琪一劍一信,著其下山投效義軍首領夏子龍

programme.title: 白蛇傳
programme.desc: 妖精白素貞跟妹妹青青在凡間巧遇前世救命恩人書生許仙,後更以身相許給許仙。後和尚法海揭穿其身份並把這對苦命鴛鴦拆散

programme.title: 十二金錢鏢
programme.desc: 喬茂押鏢時,遇女贼袁玉蓉,舉刀要殺之際,卻被袁的美麗媚態吸引,後兩人互生愛慕,更發現憑獨門武器「十二金錢鏢」名震天下的俞劍平,與背後操控袁的老頭,有段血海深仇…

programme.title: 花團錦簇
programme.desc: 時裝設計師史馬哥向葉德梅徵求她對自己作品的意見,梅卻隨意提出批評,這讓馬哥感到非常不滿。一天,梅準備出席一場盛大的宴會,於是找馬哥為她設計禮服,不料他為報復故意設計了一件小丑裝,讓梅顏面盡失。最終,史馬哥卻很內疚並向梅道歉,兩人冰釋前嫌,並墜入愛河。

programme.title: 燕娘
programme.desc: 李飛龍要出行送鏢,行前囑咐好友王天彪代照顧自己的鏢局及妻兒,不料,天彪竟先誘姦飛龍之妻子,後殺鏢局眾徒,更伏兵襲擊飛龍一行人等。飛龍死裏逃生,請師侄英傑往保護女兒燕娘

programme.title: 菁菁
programme.desc: 故事講述茶居老闆女菁菁與伐木工羅貴生相戀,菁父聞說惡霸看中菁,忙找生籌備婚事;不料翌日生即奉命運送木材進城,只得與菁暫別。生進城後,鎮上即有謠言,說生已在城裡另訂親事;另一方面菁無意中發現惡霸向寡婦施暴,寡婦不甘受辱自殺,惡霸欲殺人滅口,菁身陷險境。

programme.title: 豪俠傳
programme.desc: 平西王因與金龍山強盜結仇,女兒被擄走。他非常焦急,請劍俠岳震北幫忙,嶽估計一人之力不夠,幸得多位武功高強的好友相助一同去金龍山破盜寨。各人步步小心,希望能成功救人。

programme.title: 魂斷奈何天
programme.desc: 良才見秋容貌美,心懷不軌,竟將其迷姦。秋容醒來後為良才甜言蜜意所惑,相信他稟明父母後會娶她為妻。誰知數月後,良才音訊全無,秋容更發現自已懷有身孕,於是馬上去找良才。可惜那時秋容才發現良才已另娶名門閨秀為妻,更打算將秋容滅口…

programme.title: 盜兵符
programme.desc: 本片是一部戰國時代歷史武俠片。故事描述,秦攻魏鄰趙國,魏信陵君與朱亥為救國,代魏王妃嬪如姬報父仇,以請姬盜魏王兵符,發兵救趙

programme.title: 亞洲秘密警察
programme.desc: 走私黃金的犯罪組織首領喬治伊頓潛逃香港,亞洲秘密警察日本支部探員楊明軒遠赴香港緝凶,期間結識香港密探賴雨田,更週旋於美女杏子、春子及楊明華之間。明軒收到情報,喬治欲與澳門賭場負責人卡洛斯將黃金送往日本;明軒與賴雨田趕上船去阻止,與喬治展開惡鬥

programme.title: 三笑
programme.desc: 風流才子唐伯虎邂逅了丫鬟秋香,被她所吸引,遂決定隱瞞身份,進入華家作書僮,藉此接近秋香,並向她表明自己的身份和來意,可惜秋香並不相信。最後,唐伯虎憑藉其出眾的個人才智及好友的協助下,終於抱得美人歸。

programme.title: 梁山伯與祝英台
programme.desc: 祝英台女扮男裝入學堂求學,並與同窗梁山伯結下至死不渝的深情厚愛。山伯得知英台真實身份後,立即前往祝家提親,豈料英台早已被許配他人,二人被迫含淚分離。山伯因悲痛過度,一病不起,最終含恨離世。英台驚聞噩耗,悲痛欲絕,哭祭山伯墳前,更縱身躍入墓中,以身殉情。

programme.title: 黑靈官
programme.desc: 人稱「黑靈官」的宮天龍,押解殺人犯關雲飛時遇上大風雪,被迫在宮天龍家留宿。當晚關雲飛獲同夥所救,逃脫前更砍殺宮天龍之母及幼妹。其後,宮天龍因押解囚犯不利,被打入大牢。宮天龍出獄後,誓要殺死關雲飛為家人報仇。

programme.title: 楊貴妃
programme.desc: 唐明皇十分寵愛妃子楊貴妃,導致終日尋歡作樂,荒廢國事,更將所有國事交貴妃之兄丞相楊國忠處理。丞相卻因貪贓枉法,暴虐無道,引起軍民共憤。民眾乘機造反要弒唐明皇,貴妃自知難逃一死,於是最終投繯自盡。

programme.title: 壁虎
programme.desc: 為要對付一名貪污的總警司,屢犯竊案的大賊「壁虎」,預告將在富翁的宴會中盜取鑽石。後來被總警司的孫女揭穿他真正的身份,原來是個正義凜然的年青員警。

programme.title: 女子公寓
programme.desc: 故事背景為一幢女子公寓,房東陳太太痛恨男人,嚴禁男性進入,不幸,女房客卻多靠男性而活;歌女尤淑文由台北飛到香港,找尋失蹤的妹妹;尤經作曲家王德生介紹到居所樓上之女子公寓居住

programme.title: 江湖奇俠
programme.desc: 少年桂武下山到蟠龍谷,與兒時好友兼未來妻子聯珠相見。但到達蟠龍谷後,桂武卻發現聯珠的家並非一群誠實的人。桂武欲帶聯珠離去,別無選擇下,他必須與聯珠的家人對抗…

programme.title: 蝴蝶盃
programme.desc: 明朝時代,書生田玉川因替漁夫伸張正義,誤殺總督之子,被迫逃亡。走投無路時,他逃至江畔,幸得漁夫之女相救。二人在險境中情愫暗生,玉川遂以傳家至寶「蝴蝶盃」為信物,締結終身之約。

programme.title: 斷魂谷
programme.desc: 斷魂谷趙家莊主趙雲陽有兩弟子,趙玉龍和趙劍英。玉龍終年浪蕩江湖,却得雲陽所有財産。劍英不憤,害死師父嫁禍玉龍,幷引其子金虎追殺玉龍。兩人在斷魂穀决鬥,劍英欲收漁人之利,幸金虎和玉龍發現穀中有埋伏,詐傷引出主谋,連手反攻

programme.title: 玉女親情
programme.desc: 故事講述張愛珠無意得知自己是孤兒,故往找生母。生母茱莉與流氓劉老四同居,老四心起歪念,竟欲非禮愛珠,茱莉救了女兒,卻被老四誤殺。愛珠逃回養父母家,始深深體會到養父母對她的愛。

programme.title: 無翼蝙蝠
programme.desc: 失蹤五年的無翼蝙蝠,忽然重出江湖,姦淫少女。風流大俠蕭七與總鏢頭雷迅追查真相,並發現無翼蝙蝠可能被嫁禍。傳說無翼蝙蝠的蝙蝠刀內藏有蝙蝠寶圖,於是他們將計就計,借刀引出幕後真兇…

programme.title: 青春1000日
programme.desc: 凌玫瑰與方素美是一對感情要好的同窗。凌幼失怙恃,由當舞女之姊撫養成長,方則出身富家,受母呵護備至。畢業後,凌由淪落風塵攀至選美冠軍,方則滿足於平淡生活中;但她們卻偏偏同時愛上劉醫生。最後一件意想不到的事發生,改寫了他們三人的一生…

programme.title: 洪拳小子
programme.desc: 關風義的洪拳造詣極高,經過師兄黃漢的介紹,在布廠當雜工。黃漢時常告誡關風義,萬不得已,別顯露自己懂武功,以免招惹麻煩。但年少氣盛的關風義並沒有將師兄的話聽進去,最後更因捲入兩家敵對布廠的鬥爭中而身陷險境。

programme.title: 故都春夢
programme.desc: 故事源自膾炙人口的《啼笑因緣》,內容描述民國初年,富家子范嘉恕戀上歌女岑逢仙,同時又唯賣藝少女官繡珠及貌似岑的財政廳長女兒賀莉霞所迷戀。張大帥垂涎岑,更姦污了她。嘉恕後得繡珠相助,才從大帥手中救回愛人。

programme.title: 八萬罪人
programme.desc: 香港在1953至1955年,曾被警方稱為最黑暗的時期,那時候罪惡泛濫,百弊叢生,一日可發生三十二宗驚人案件,而犯罪份子有百分之四十是積犯;英廷特派專員來港調查監獄的措施,發現獄中不良份子,濫用權力,公報私仇,歪曲政府的監獄制度,造成犯人越變越黑,監獄變成地獄。影片主角江才因不甘受探長侮辱,結果被控妨

programme.title: 八面修羅之九重鎖
programme.desc: 奧匈帝國一戰戰敗解體,戰敗國軍官卡爾和火藥專家瑪麗研製出有九重機關的炸彈,決定用炸彈一舉炸死所有協約國駐華官員,北洋對外特工組織獵盟會成員蕭乾及隊友排除萬難,拆除炸彈,最終阻止了這場陰謀,重歸和平。

programme.title: 激戰黎明
programme.desc: 這是一個有關尊嚴的故事。國家的尊嚴、民族的尊嚴、家族的尊嚴、自己的尊嚴,都在這個特定的時代發出最後的吼聲。影片中,每一個人都在為尊嚴而戰,為尊嚴而死。正是這些因為尊嚴而爆發的個體,彙聚成中國反法西斯戰爭的偉大洪流。

programme.title: 長安俠影之天譴之謎
programme.desc: 《天譴之謎》是系列武俠電影《長安俠影》的第一部,主要講述的是初唐年間,二太子李世民為剷除異己,博得父皇李淵信任,而精心設下的一個彌天大計。而江湖大俠李禦風,藥王后人血未央,紈絝子弟叱羅金偶然之中

programme.title: 野火春風斗古城

programme.title: 美國在野四季錄 #2 英普
programme.desc: 非洲的夏天是一個極端的季節,它汰弱留強,測試了獵豹,獅子,大守宮,烏龜和許多其他物種在夏季極端炎熱時覓食和尋找水源的生存本能

programme.title: 深潛北美 #5
programme.desc: 參與莉茲最驚險刺激的大西洋任務--與公牛鯊進行自由潛水探索充滿神秘氛圍的墨西哥灣濕地沼澤,那裡棲息著飢餓的鱷魚,機敏的鱷龜,還有雖然細小卻無比強韌的沙丘老鼠,牠們的存在對維持海岸穩固起著不可或缺的作用

programme.title: 熊寶貝訓練營 #1
programme.desc: 齊來認識小熊溫斯頓,這隻被遺棄的幼熊與茱蒂建立了深厚的羈絆,因為得到她全天候的照顧感受茱蒂如何忍痛切斷彼此的情感連結,並教導這個可愛的小傢伙,如何在沒有人類的野外世界,成為獨當一面的黑熊

programme.title: 熊寶貝訓練營 #2
programme.desc: 歡迎姐妹檔西巴,西拉和索拉,這三隻挨餓的孤兒讓溫斯頓的世界天翻地覆,直到溫柔的索拉教會溫斯頓友誼的意義然後關注新來的幼熊雅思敏和雅拉,牠們在經歷驚險的分離後重新相聚

programme.title: 成為大象:瑞提提的孤兒們 #2

programme.desc: 齊來認識小熊溫斯頓,這隻被遺棄的幼熊與茱蒂建立了深厚的羈絆,因為得到她全天候的照顧感受茱蒂如何忍痛切斷彼此的情感連結,並教導這個可愛的小傢伙,如何在沒有人類的野外世界,成為獨當一面的黑熊

programme.title: 與伊恩·華納一同探索愛爾蘭荒野島嶼 #3
programme.desc: 了解北極燕鷗如何途徑5萬英里的路途抵達凱里的馬哈里群島避暑在布蘭登岬附近觀賞鯨魚,然後目睹愛爾蘭最壯觀的野生動物奇觀:大布拉斯科特島上的1000隻灰海豹棲息地

programme.title: 深潛北美 #6
programme.desc: ​裹上厚厚保暖衣物,莉姿向北出發,標記鯊魚行蹤,親眼目睹海冰逐漸融解的緩慢,令人警醒的消逝​在「熊監獄」裡度過一段時光,與那些被捕捉後暫時安置的北極熊共處,牠們因為冰封獵場縮減,被迫闖入人類城鎮尋找食物,為求一餐,走上危險之途

programme.title: 「非」常野外又一年 #3 英普
programme.desc: 非洲的秋天帶來了機遇南非毛皮海豹,薩曼哥猴子,變色龍,黑斑羚和更多其他動物感應著季節的變化秋天使許多動物的生活發生了變化珍稀生物現身,食肉動物聚集起來獲取優勢

programme.title: 「非」常野外又一年 #4 英普
programme.desc: 親眼目睹冬天給非洲帶來的死亡和復活吧從乾旱到寒風,觀察白晝的縮短會帶來什麼,並驚歎於動物和植物在面對季節的狂暴時的生存技能

programme.title: 巨象同盟:長牙兄弟情
programme.desc: 沉浸於「長牙雄象」錯綜複雜的生活世界,認識三頭處於不同生命階段的非洲雄象:克雷格,帕斯卡與以掃深入一窺全球最大陸生哺乳類那細緻微妙的交流語言,複雜的社群互動,以及彼此之間深厚而緊密的情感連結

programme.title: 海洋饕餮盛宴 英普
programme.desc: 前排觀看地球上最大規模的生物量遷移,即每年沿南非東海岸1000英里的沙丁魚風暴數十億條小魚倉皇躲避著饑餓的捕食者,其中包括隱秘的海豹和潛水炸彈般的塘鵝

programme.title: 非洲野狗:族群對獅群 #6
programme.desc: 和卡昆比族群一起返回巢穴,這個族群正在哀悼兩隻失去的幼崽偶遇一個鬣狗窩和一頭獅子試圖放倒一頭水牛的場面,然後跟上曼齊族群的步伐,目睹牠們與一隻豹子和一群憤怒大象的對峙

programme.title: 極地奧秘 #1
programme.desc: 哈德遜灣低窪地是北美最大濕地的一部分 超過300,000平方公里的厚苔沼,一處巨大的沼澤地,放眼望去可以看到以水浸泡的泥煤,苔蘚和矮木的特色生態曾被視為荒地,但現在人們都知道這些沼澤對地球上的生命尤關重要在全球的濕地中存在的二氧化碳跟大氣中一樣多,泥煤地生態系統是地球上最有效的碳吸儲庫

programme.title: 極限非洲 #1
programme.desc: 南非的龍山是其中一處擁有大陸上最壯麗美景的地方它的氣候和生態梯度急劇變化,亦影響著陸空生物和天上猛禽的生活環境

programme.title: 極限非洲 #2
programme.desc: 在坦桑尼亞北部,高聳的山脈形成一個巨大的山谷它被古老的火山所滋養,坡道為生命提供了多元化的棲息地,而它巨大的重心地帶即使在最乾燥的時期也能保存水源

programme.title: 極限非洲 #3
programme.desc: 埃塞俄比亞的塞米恩國家公園住著地球上一些最稀有的生物窺探非洲最高峰的生活,那是在草原遊走毛茸茸的獅尾狒,神出鬼沒的塞米恩狼和有角的瓦利亞野山羊的最後堡壘

programme.title: 極限非洲 #4
programme.desc: 進入南部旱地是一趟非洲南部最遠端,最乾旱和極端環境的旅程我們到訪了幾乎不降雨,既壯觀又危險的地方,為了尋找適應力極強的動物,並了解牠們生存的秘密從最大的哺乳類到最敏捷的昆蟲,甚至是世上僅有幽靈般的魚類,南部旱地擁有非凡的居民,生活在世上其中一處最荒涼的棲息地接受日常挑戰,牠們都站在同一陣線

programme.title: 極限非洲 #5
programme.desc: 現已乾涸的埃托沙曾是一個大湖,現在只有夏季降雨期間才能季節性地補充水分但當埃托沙充滿水時,無數的水鳥就會聚集在淺湖中繁殖,最常見的是大小紅鸛

programme.title: 極限非洲 #6
programme.desc: 沿著南非的奧蘭治河,從它的源頭到大西洋出海處我們在沿途能遇到各樣的棲息地和當中的生物,從理察斯維德的旱地到奧赫拉比斯的美景; 這是一個線形綠洲的故事我們將揭示生物如何適應其河道,並發現豐富的動植物世界

programme.title: 大貓國度 #6
programme.desc: 旱季即將結束,孟巴肯高獅群面臨前所未有的艱難時刻牠們的女族長和最強獵人蘇拉比被一頭水牛所傷,讓她命懸一線同時,彌敦找到了獅群中最年輕的成員之一,孤身走失的小獅斑點

programme.title: 驕傲之地:野地回春
programme.desc: 一個澳洲家庭在南非的一個古老狩獵牧場進行修復他們的目標是重建過度生長的棲息地,建立生態旅游牧場,並允許包括獵食者在內的自然野生動植物搬回家

programme.title: 成為大象:瑞提提的孤兒們 #1
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​探索由社區經營的瑞特提大象庇護所,在這裡,人類的代理媽媽們透過玩耍教導小象如何在野外生存,並細心地照顧與陪伴牠們成長與那隻失去象鼻的小象隆烏洛建立情感連結,同時了解為什麼六歲的小象凱勒勒那場神祕的疾病,可能會讓牠的重返野外之路被迫延遲

programme.title: 成為大象:瑞提提的孤兒們 #2
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​在道別的傷痛與對未來的希望之間尋求平衡,因為這一代被救援的大象,終於迎來了重返自由的時刻歡迎瑞特提大家庭的新成員:一頭從水坑中被救出的象寶寶,以及一匹名叫奇希瑪的斑馬,牠曾因創傷而驚恐不安

programme.title: 巨象同盟:長牙兄弟情
programme.desc: 沉浸於「長牙雄象」錯綜複雜的生活世界,認識三頭處於不同生命階段的非洲雄象:克雷格,帕斯卡與以掃深入一窺全球最大陸生哺乳類那細緻微妙的交流語言,複雜的社群互動,以及彼此之間深厚而緊密的情感連結

programme.title: 深藍巨獸 #6 英普
programme.desc: 前往科克群島旅遊,這是3000只座頭鯨準備交配和撫養幼崽的首選目的地見證巨蚌和綠海龜在島嶼巨大的珊瑚礁中繁衍生息,並一瞥我們的進化歷史

programme.title: 超獸 #5
programme.desc: 向大自然中最古老,最致命的耐力型掠食者之一低頭致敬看虎鯊如何利用海龜築巢時的混亂展開獵食,和肩章鯊一起在缺氧環境中生存,並和幽靈鯊一起承受深海驚人的高壓

programme.title: 超獸 #6
programme.desc: 跟著各式各樣的鯊魚在海洋中巡游,看看為什麼這些掠食性魚類能夠稱霸海底世界和礁鯊一起穿梭在珊瑚迷宮之中,和鬚鯊一起潛伏等待最完美的攻擊時機,並和大白鯊一起展開史詩般的大遷徙

programme.title: 超獸 #1
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​沉浸在動物王國中最強大生物的驚人力量之中與銀背大猩猩一起衝破堅硬的白蟻丘,觀察能夠壓碎凱門鱷頭骨的美洲豹,然後前往海洋目睹虎鯨成群獵食的情景

programme.title: 動物格鬥士 #1 英普
programme.desc: 見證鬥士們如何在非洲大草原的旱季中爭奪水源和其他珍貴資源親眼目擊獅子和大象為爭奪地盤的激烈爭鬥,螞蟻襲擊白蟻丘,以及蜜獾與毒蛇聯袂上演的危險探戈

programme.title: 動物格鬥士 #2 英普
programme.desc: 拜訪澳洲最狡猾的鬥士和他們驚人的武器庫從袋鼠的致命拳擊和紅背蜘蛛精密設計的陷阱,暸解他們如何運用這些必殺技擊退敵人,同時應對氣候變化的侵害

programme.title: 喀爾巴阡獵手 #1 英普
programme.desc: 喀爾巴阡山脈橫跨七個歐洲國家;它有著廣闊的原始森林,陡峭的峽谷和孤立的山峰,為這片大陸最具魅力的生物提供了寶貴的避難所

programme.title: 非洲野狗:族群對獅群 #4
programme.desc: 跟隨來自ZCP的朱爾茲和亨利一起追跡卡昆比幼崽,目睹牠們與一隻倔强的,長著獠牙的疣豬之間的對峙,過程中還會邂逅一頭大象跟隨ZCP的獅子專家珊迪·穆維特瓦(Thandie Mwetwa),他正在統計將曼齊族群趕出領地的獅群

programme.title: 美國在野四季錄 #1 英普
programme.desc: 南非的春天從9月初開始,大自然變得生氣盎 然日照變長,氣溫上升,動植物緊密合作繁殖,生育和養育幼兒

programme.title: 美國在野四季錄 #2 英普
programme.desc: 非洲的夏天是一個極端的季節,它汰弱留強,測試了獵豹,獅子,大守宮,烏龜和許多其他物種在夏季極端炎熱時覓食和尋找水源的生存本能

programme.title: 深潛北美 #5
programme.desc: 參與莉茲最驚險刺激的大西洋任務--與公牛鯊進行自由潛水探索充滿神秘氛圍的墨西哥灣濕地沼澤,那裡棲息著飢餓的鱷魚,機敏的鱷龜,還有雖然細小卻無比強韌的沙丘老鼠,牠們的存在對維持海岸穩固起著不可或缺的作用

programme.title: 熊寶貝訓練營 #1

programme.title: 熊寶貝訓練營 #2

programme.title: 成為大象:瑞提提的孤兒們 #2

programme.title: 非洲野狗:族群對獅群 #6
programme.desc: 和卡昆比族群一起返回巢穴,這個族群正在哀悼兩隻失去的幼崽偶遇一個鬣狗窩和一頭獅子試圖放倒一頭水牛的場面,然後跟上曼齊族群的步伐,目睹牠們與一隻豹子和一群憤怒大象的對峙

programme.title: 極地奧秘 #1
programme.desc: 哈德遜灣低窪地是北美最大濕地的一部分 超過300,000平方公里的厚苔沼,一處巨大的沼澤地,放眼望去可以看到以水浸泡的泥煤,苔蘚和矮木的特色生態曾被視為荒地,但現在人們都知道這些沼澤對地球上的生命尤關重要在全球的濕地中存在的二氧化碳跟大氣中一樣多,泥煤地生態系統是地球上最有效的碳吸儲庫

programme.title: 極限非洲 #1
programme.desc: 南非的龍山是其中一處擁有大陸上最壯麗美景的地方它的氣候和生態梯度急劇變化,亦影響著陸空生物和天上猛禽的生活環境

programme.title: 極限非洲 #2
programme.desc: 在坦桑尼亞北部,高聳的山脈形成一個巨大的山谷它被古老的火山所滋養,坡道為生命提供了多元化的棲息地,而它巨大的重心地帶即使在最乾燥的時期也能保存水源

programme.title: 極限非洲 #3
programme.desc: 埃塞俄比亞的塞米恩國家公園住著地球上一些最稀有的生物窺探非洲最高峰的生活,那是在草原遊走毛茸茸的獅尾狒,神出鬼沒的塞米恩狼和有角的瓦利亞野山羊的最後堡壘

programme.title: 極限非洲 #4
programme.desc: 進入南部旱地是一趟非洲南部最遠端,最乾旱和極端環境的旅程我們到訪了幾乎不降雨,既壯觀又危險的地方,為了尋找適應力極強的動物,並了解牠們生存的秘密從最大的哺乳類到最敏捷的昆蟲,甚至是世上僅有幽靈般的魚類,南部旱地擁有非凡的居民,生活在世上其中一處最荒涼的棲息地接受日常挑戰,牠們都站在同一陣線

programme.title: 極限非洲 #5
programme.desc: 現已乾涸的埃托沙曾是一個大湖,現在只有夏季降雨期間才能季節性地補充水分但當埃托沙充滿水時,無數的水鳥就會聚集在淺湖中繁殖,最常見的是大小紅鸛

programme.title: 極限非洲 #6
programme.desc: 沿著南非的奧蘭治河,從它的源頭到大西洋出海處我們在沿途能遇到各樣的棲息地和當中的生物,從理察斯維德的旱地到奧赫拉比斯的美景; 這是一個線形綠洲的故事我們將揭示生物如何適應其河道,並發現豐富的動植物世界

programme.title: 大貓國度 #6
programme.desc: 旱季即將結束,孟巴肯高獅群面臨前所未有的艱難時刻牠們的女族長和最強獵人蘇拉比被一頭水牛所傷,讓她命懸一線同時,彌敦找到了獅群中最年輕的成員之一,孤身走失的小獅斑點

programme.title: 驕傲之地:野地回春
programme.desc: 一個澳洲家庭在南非的一個古老狩獵牧場進行修復他們的目標是重建過度生長的棲息地,建立生態旅游牧場,並允許包括獵食者在內的自然野生動植物搬回家

programme.title: 成為大象:瑞提提的孤兒們 #1
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​探索由社區經營的瑞特提大象庇護所,在這裡,人類的代理媽媽們透過玩耍教導小象如何在野外生存,並細心地照顧與陪伴牠們成長與那隻失去象鼻的小象隆烏洛建立情感連結,同時了解為什麼六歲的小象凱勒勒那場神祕的疾病,可能會讓牠的重返野外之路被迫延遲

programme.title: 成為大象:瑞提提的孤兒們 #2
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​在道別的傷痛與對未來的希望之間尋求平衡,因為這一代被救援的大象,終於迎來了重返自由的時刻歡迎瑞特提大家庭的新成員:一頭從水坑中被救出的象寶寶,以及一匹名叫奇希瑪的斑馬,牠曾因創傷而驚恐不安

programme.title: 巨象同盟:長牙兄弟情
programme.desc: 沉浸於「長牙雄象」錯綜複雜的生活世界,認識三頭處於不同生命階段的非洲雄象:克雷格,帕斯卡與以掃深入一窺全球最大陸生哺乳類那細緻微妙的交流語言,複雜的社群互動,以及彼此之間深厚而緊密的情感連結

programme.title: 深藍巨獸 #6 英普
programme.desc: 前往科克群島旅遊,這是3000只座頭鯨準備交配和撫養幼崽的首選目的地見證巨蚌和綠海龜在島嶼巨大的珊瑚礁中繁衍生息,並一瞥我們的進化歷史

programme.title: 超獸 #5
programme.desc: 向大自然中最古老,最致命的耐力型掠食者之一低頭致敬看虎鯊如何利用海龜築巢時的混亂展開獵食,和肩章鯊一起在缺氧環境中生存,並和幽靈鯊一起承受深海驚人的高壓

programme.title: 超獸 #6
programme.desc: 跟著各式各樣的鯊魚在海洋中巡游,看看為什麼這些掠食性魚類能夠稱霸海底世界和礁鯊一起穿梭在珊瑚迷宮之中,和鬚鯊一起潛伏等待最完美的攻擊時機,並和大白鯊一起展開史詩般的大遷徙

programme.title: 超獸 #1
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​沉浸在動物王國中最強大生物的驚人力量之中與銀背大猩猩一起衝破堅硬的白蟻丘,觀察能夠壓碎凱門鱷頭骨的美洲豹,然後前往海洋目睹虎鯨成群獵食的情景

programme.desc: 見證鬥士們如何在非洲大草原的旱季中爭奪水源和其他珍貴資源親眼目擊獅子和大象為爭奪地盤的激烈爭鬥,螞蟻襲擊白蟻丘,以及蜜獾與毒蛇聯袂上演的危險探戈

programme.title: 威廉斯姊妹
programme.desc: 威廉斯姐妹從沒有一個姓氏能與網球運動同義與傷病,爭議和一躍成名的壓力鬥爭,很少運動員能說她們能取得威廉斯一樣的成就從白紙般的青少年到經驗豐富的老兵,無人能預測出姐妹倆的職業生涯,或者她們又能嗎?

programme.title: 摩根費裡曼:打破障礙
programme.desc: 摩根費裡曼是好萊塢最知名的演員之一,以其有力的聲線和溫文的舉止見稱儘管他的特質廣為人知,但真實的他卻不是眾所周知

programme.title: 犀牛孤兒院 #1
programme.desc: 在犀牛孤兒院需要耐性與忠誠,因為他們要撫養那些因偷獵而失去母親的年輕犀牛

programme.title: 犀牛孤兒院 #2
programme.desc: 兩頭最老的犀牛將重返大自然三頭犀牛的失蹤引起鬨動,而年輕的犀牛則逐漸康復和變得快樂

programme.title: 犀牛孤兒院 #3
programme.desc: 偷獵危機加劇,偷獵者將注意力轉向孤兒們四周大的牙美拿失去母親後終於在犀牛孤兒院找到庇護

programme.title: 進化中的素食者 #1
programme.desc: 文拿與朋友莉莉星和蘿拉馬拉諾一起串餐廳,沉浸在植物性飲食中,法式糕點,五香牛肉炸角,泰式雞翼和燒牛扒

programme.title: 進化中的素食者 #2
programme.desc: 多元化的大廚們製作垂涎欲滴的素餃子,炸雞三文治和越南鯰魚;文拿尋找龍蝦蘑菇並參觀美國最古老的豆腐廠

programme.title: 進化中的素食者 #3
programme.desc: 文拿探索他加拿大的後院,發現美味的素壽司,開心果奶油甜餡煎餅捲和薄餅;他與喜劇演員巴森尤瑟夫一起在一家素芝士廠試工

programme.title: 任天堂的故事
programme.desc: 由製造花札卡牌默默發跡,到成為世上最受認可的電子遊戲公司之一,從瑪利歐和路易吉的誕生到大金剛和薩爾達⋯⋯到擊敗競爭對手並成為高品質遊戲和強大價值的平臺這就是任天堂的故事

programme.title: 非凡工程 2 #1
programme.desc: 位於漢堡芬肯維德的空中巴士工廠擁有超過 16,000名工人和工程師設計,生產和交付整個歐盟中那些業內領先的飛機

programme.title: 非凡工程 2 #2
programme.desc: 每十分鐘就有一輛新卡車從生產線出貨,配備了度身訂制的生產線,以滿足瑞典汽車集團-富豪的個別客戶需求

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: The white cockatoo is one of the more common macaw species, but its number in the wild has gradually declined in recent years Hand-reared white cockatoos love to be close to their owners Their large size is one of their features Like other large macaws, white cockatoos are really loud, but if it's a hand-reared bird raised from a young age, the situation of screaming will be much better If you want to raise a pair of adult birds, it is ideal to keep them in an open area with good sound insulation or without neighbors Their friendly personalities make them one of the more suitable large macaw species as pets

programme.title: Destination
programme.desc: Doused in heritage with old hamlets, drowsy villages and towns studding its lush green hills, Southern France’s Occitania region only officially come into being in 2016 with the pairing of Languedoc-Roussillon and the Midi-Pyrenees The two historically Occitan regions are blessed with colour, tranquility, and a wealth of UNESCO World Heritage Sites Food and drink are still approached with reverence in the region, and a whistle stop tour around four different departments of the Midi Pyrenees; Tarn, Gers, Tarn-et-Garonne and Haute Garonne gives you plenty of opportunity to experience some of its best gastronomy, as Katy Dartford discovers

programme.title: Essence Of India
programme.desc: Samira is all excited for the Tandoori PartynnThe world loves to BBQ and India has some of the oldest forms – Tandoori cooking Samira takes a fresh approach to Tandoori cuisine and the grill that goes back thousands of years nnThe Episode starts off with a visit to a Street Tandoori hub that makes Kababs that have a cult following of their own Samira ends up taking over grill, learns the art of Tandoori breads and how can any Tandoori feast be complete without the Pièce de résistance, The Tandoori Chicken and a Party!

programme.title: Essence Of India
programme.desc: Samira is in New York, getting ready for an exciting trip back home to India, where she re-visits Indian cuisine with her New York culinary trained eye She packs her bags and sets off nnNew York’s signature street food is the hot dog In India, street food is a highly developed cuisine all on its own, going back hundreds of years Samira has her own take on the shammi kabab and turns them into mini burgers in her kitchen, before traipsing all over New Delhi in her Essence of India auto rickshaw devouring the hearty Samosa, the succulent Kathi wraps, the moorishly moist Biryanis and even ends up taking over a street cart with a smorgasbord of sweet, tangy and spicy Indian chaat

programme.title: I Can't Breathe
programme.desc: Police brutality against marginalised communities is not isolated to American shores In 2015, David Dungay Jr, an Aboriginal Australian, died in police custody The coroner later found a “lack of oxygen while he was restrained as a contributing factor to his death”, drawing disturbing parallels with the death of George Floyd in May this year Stan Grant, himself of Aboriginal heritage, feels a kinship across the continents “When I see black America, I see part of myself When I was growing up black America spoke to me when white Australia did not” For those who believe race is no longer an issue that needs discussion, he has a simple message “Why do we still talk about racism? Because it still exists Because it is there Because it can touch my life at any time”

programme.title: 主日講壇-中國基督教播道會同福堂
programme.desc: 中國基督教播道會同福堂 講題:出人意表 人每一天都要面對很多抉擇,要將上帝的智慧應用在生活不同層面中是一件不容易的事情,而在牧師和傳道人的講道中,往往都能夠得到啟迪。透過主日講壇,更明白神的道並在生活中尋求到神喜悅的心意。

programme.title: 靈修早晨
programme.desc: 每天早晨透過詩歌安靜心靈,從牧者及嘉賓的分享學習《聖經》中的真理,讓觀眾由淺入深認識信仰,默想《聖經》教導。

programme.title: 來!為這城禱告
programme.desc: 你們要為那城求平安,為那城禱告耶和華;因為那城得平安,你們也隨著得平安。(耶29:7)

programme.title: 地球深度行V 大地的寶藏
programme.desc: 攝製隊走訪美國、英國、 瑞士、澳洲、土耳其、以色列、埃及、中國及亞洲等國家,訪尋學者專家多年來從大地發掘的寶藏及科研成果,當中包括高山上經歷大洪水形成的奇異化石;全球首卷手抄絲綢中文聖經;以色列鑄造挪亞方舟金幣場等。n一切一切的資料,讓觀眾在欣賞地球的創造同時,見證上帝的奇妙創作及精密設計,從心感受

programme.title: 你是主角
programme.desc: 有人說,人生是一場戲,在人生的過程中,尋找有時、碰壁有時、迷失有時、覺醒有時,說真的,這些起承轉合比真正的電影情節更精彩,每一個「你」,都是天父特別設計的人生劇本主角。 今天,我們的世界充滿了末世風情,醉生夢死、迷失自我了結生命的悲劇每天上演,創世電視藉100個見證故事挽救生命,100位來自世界各地

programme.title: 如果還有明天

programme.title: 創世電視復興祭壇
programme.desc: 與影音使團創世電視成為一家人,一起在「創世電視復興祭壇」,以禱告和敬拜守望香港。

programme.title: 屬靈教室:何偉強牧師-廿一世紀的屬靈人
programme.desc: 迷惘、沒有方向、疲乏,面對社會上的各種難題和困境,我們應該怎樣做,才能成為合符上帝心意的人? 何偉強牧師將會一連十三集,透過哥林多前書,與你講述處世之道。

programme.title: 屬靈教室:李盛林牧師-出埃及記
programme.desc: 前無去路,後有追兵,憑信心過紅海。n雲柱火柱日夜引路,天降嗎哪為持生命。n流浪曠野四十年,以色列人用血、淚、性命寫成的感人見證!n今天,對你有甚麼啟示呢?n李盛林牧師與你深入探討《出埃及記》中的主要資訊,讓信徒掌握此書卷之意義,並如何落實應用於現今世代。

programme.title: 喜樂婆婆會客室
programme.desc: 主持小金子喬媽,人稱「喜樂婆婆」,一生經歷操練出一套喜樂心得,她更請來一眾嘉賓好友,分享人生中大小風浪,靠著的是同出一轍的喜樂秘訣,在節目中娓娓道出那份屬天的快樂。

programme.title: 聖地流動教室-以色列破謎之旅

programme.title: 聖地流動教室-以色列破謎之旅
programme.desc: 通曉中西方歷史、文學、藝術、民間傳說的學者吳宗文牧師,以及主持梁藝齡,透過鏡頭帶著電視觀眾,去到聖地各站遊歷,呈現出新舊約的《聖經》典故、歷史文獻的記載、相關的猶太傳說和傳統習俗,而更重要是從耶穌和初期信徒的記載,帶出人生的重要特質,助你成就非凡人生。

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
高朋滿座#152粵
programme.desc: 溢致電公司熱線求助，接線生Sugar有甜美聲線，令溢對她留有好印象。溢到電腦店拿取已訂的軟件，卻被坐輪椅之女子捷足先登，因而起衝突，該女子更用輪椅輾其腳。溢再得Sugar幫助，令溢對其更添好感。

programme.title: 命轉皇后#27粵普PG
programme.desc: 謝危為救姜雪寧，假意答應平南王，給燕牧去信請他帶兵南下。燕家軍捷報連連，平南王甚為滿意，同意謝危辦端午宴的提議。呂顯分析謝危的來信，破解出暗藏訊息。端午宴上，平南王卻要謝危親自毀掉姜雪寧的手以示忠心…

programme.title: 食平3D粵
programme.desc: 赤小豆和扁豆有袪濕功效，配合野生粉葛、鯽魚，成為「野生粉葛赤小豆粟米湯」。炮製「鮮蠔烙」秘訣是「蠔粒夠小、粉漿夠稠」，加入蔥蒜粒、紅椒絲等可錦上添花。還有酸甜惹味「梅子蒸排骨」、「上湯杞子浸枸杞 」。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 泌尿道結石由礦物質的積聚超過臨界點而成，病徵要待一段長時間才顯現。泌尿外科醫生指，會透過抽血、尿液檢查、造影檢查來診斷此症。患者可接受哪三類治療方法，各有甚麼利弊或副作用？游泳運動員除了密集操水，原來還要練好核心肌群，輕度智障游泳運動員張浚諾卻樂在其中，同來的教練大讚其運動員精神、修養、品行皆優秀。浚諾首次參加全國特奧會，就奪得五面金牌，感受如何？「睇餸食飯」，傅季馨炮製「咖喱白汁海鮮焗腸粉」。

programme.title: 吃貨橫掃深圳粵
programme.desc: 把原條江團魚放進石鍋，煮出奶白色的鮮甜湯底，成為滋味火鍋，吃貨們食得滿足。位於南山區花卉中心的咖啡店，令人仿如置身法國的庭園景致，吸引女士們瘋狂打卡。日式餐廳選用鰻魚、鵝肝等炮製和風Taco，還有海膽配牛角包，難怪女生不顧儀態張嘴享用。掃食寶安區的夜市一條街，眾吃貨將鉢鉢雞串燒、黑色臭豆腐、花甲粉、荊州鍋盔等小食，統統掃入肚中。這集還會「開箱」存倉式超市的人氣急凍烤鴨與漢堡，秀怡讚CP值甚高！

programme.title: 東坡家事#13粵PG
programme.desc: 東坡走訪刑部追查洩題事件。小妹遇劫，徐淑眉為救小妹受傷昏迷，甦醒後失憶。晚上淑眉找小妹相伴，小妹展示送少游的簪花，其後遍尋不獲。東坡喬裝追查洩題事件；行雷閃電晚上，淑眉潛入東坡書房，驚見他站在門外……

programme.title: 科學×冒險 絕境求生手冊粵日
programme.desc: 一個寒冷的夜晚，市民耗電量隨之大增。一座發電廠出現故障，加上種種巧合重疊，導致全市鎮陷入大停電！沈武與兩兄妹被困在商場的升解機，孫女茱爾收到求救，立即與智悟等人前往救援，卻遭逢道路大塞車……

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 今集「WORKOUT 2GETHER」動動身體之餘，亦訓練一下拍子感。第一節先是跟節奏拍掌及拍大腿，拍的次數還會有所變化；踢腿也可加入打拍子元素。微蹲移動配合手部揮動的動作，都有助訓練全身肌力。第二節腿部練習，融入模仿動物的元素，為運動提升趣味性，讓小朋友更易投入。蹲下扮鴨仔四處走，並嘗試轉圈。扮猩猩時，手部變得「忙碌」？隨後速度放慢，化身成樹懶。扮兔仔要不停踢腳；模仿熊爬行，還能鍛練平衡力。

programme.title: 皇家少女樂團粵日
programme.desc: 對於出身演藝世家的識邊燎來��，愛麗絲比亞是一個讓她自由自在，不被他人特別看待的夢幻國度。為了守護這片樂土，她竭盡全力仍會在所不惜。與此同時，由於三公主的多番阻撓，史納樂隊終於動上真格。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵

programme.desc: 尚善等人有不少發現，擔心眾人離開後，樹根的生活會出現問題，都想將他留在自己身邊。眾人分別將要出埠工作，都提出可偕樹根同行，樹根遂讓眾人安排行程，輪流前赴不同地方旅行散心，率先跟樹仁前赴非洲拍攝動物，繼而隨城安轉往吳旺達，再與尚善、潮偉到內地遊玩，本以為過程優遊寫意，怎料令他吃盡苦頭。若水、龔燁帶同樹根到二人即將移居的群島生活，為樹根安排不少驚喜，樹根生活自在，此時下了一個重大決定……

programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.desc: 城安、Bonnie意外成為吳旺達合法夫妻。牙斬斬以打擊假結婚為由，展開為期兩週的調查，若發現二人並無夫妻之實，婚姻即告無效。Bonnie搬入熊家，與城安假扮夫妻，並為防吳旺達相關人員查問而作準備，其間回想起當初表白情景。另一方面，城安為救蔥頭必須履行嚴苛要求，獲Bonnie協助，兩人展現密契……其後，牙斬斬差點揭破二人假結婚的秘密，熊家眾人此時得知根據吳旺達法例，假結婚原來有極為嚴重的後果……

programme.title: 森下仁丹Bifina Si 益生菌呈獻：非份之罪#25粵PG
programme.desc: (大結局)有方、雅淇二人一番經歷後，有方再向雅淇求婚，雅淇答應，慧蘭卻有意阻撓。有方發現慧蘭擁有童養媳畫像身上某特徵，開始有所懷疑，恐怕慧蘭才是童養媳轉世，回來報復，決定搬往雅淇家暫住，以策安全。雅淇安撫有方，有方卻在親熱時錯叫紫遙名字，導致二人爭執……二人再度陷入前世恩怨關係，此時一件重要事發生……

programme.title: 宏利保險呈獻：重症解密粵
programme.desc: 這次由真實病患改編的案例主角因上樓梯容易氣喘而求診，檢查後竟確診大腸癌，原來貧血亦可能是此症病徵？「調查科」查出患者多肉少菜的飲食習慣、經常久坐不動，都有機會是誘發此症的成因。接受大腸內視鏡檢查可準確偵測病變，陳家亮教授指透過現時的AI系統，能更精準辨識大腸內的瘜肉。他亦強調，如能及早發現，早期的大腸癌有機會完全根治。而內鏡黏膜下剝離術(ESD)治療，病人不需全身麻醉，並能減低腸道破裂及出血風險。

programme.title: 翻身蜜語#5粵普
programme.desc: 酒店一位老年客人突發心梗，蜜語和紀封合力救人後對彼此有所改觀。紀封懷疑客房的洗髮水有問題，讓蜜語幫忙拿樣品來調查，被彩露注意到。蜜語與人換班，雷先生不滿投訴，貞貞要求蜜語道歉，蜜語無法拒絕，只能自救。

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵 及 卓正醫療呈獻：全家健康攻略粵
再創世紀#13粵
programme.desc: 定垚秘密約見建業，被他怪責不了解物流運作。明晞看中程凱有助活化計劃，提出投資三千萬與他簽約，令翹鼓勵接受，程凱心動。Karen發現思妤在家暈倒，高哲收到消息即趕往溫哥華。澤雨看見明晞的合約，以為程凱會退出比賽，怒責他為錢放棄兄弟情。創作比賽開始，程凱卻遲遲未出現……有人煽動工人引起衝突，定垚到場安撫，答應三日內解決，有人再發動襲擊，把事情搞砸。定垚難過自責，澤雨利用視像給她打氣，承諾永遠支持她。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 惡性外耳炎屬罕見且嚴重的耳道感染，主要由綠膿桿菌引起，病者會出現聽力受損、劇烈耳痛、流出異常分泌物等症狀。耳鼻喉科醫生講解糖尿病患者為何屬高危群組，並帶來相關診治資訊。殿堂級舞台服裝與形象設計師陳華國入行四十年，回想與張叔平合力為羅文打造新形象，挑戰以紙質設計舞台戰衣，但羅文起初卻不喜歡？陳華國又憶述為陳慧嫻打造告別演唱會的戰衣，更要助她「增肥」？「睇餸食飯」，Annie師傅示範「蔥油雞絲撈麵」。

programme.title: 玩轉深中懶人包粵PG
programme.desc: 陳煒帶隊遊中山，「好玩隊」率先安排石岐乳鴿宴，紅燒風乾鴿、鴿丸配老鴿火鍋湯底，滋味連連！張彥博要藉鴿腎「以形補形」？「夠歎隊」請外援出「蕉」還擊，細味蕉蕾粥、火焰海螺等私房菜，順道一探文青熱點。深入魚場發掘蠶豆餵飼脆肉鯇的秘密，見識餐廳廚師切薄魚片功架。清水鍋突顯脆肉鯇的鮮味，脆肉鯇九食還有甚麼驚喜？四出奔波後寫意歎溫泉，有人為節目犧牲色相？溫泉酒店還特設親子房，「大公主」陳曉華、關楓馨重拾童趣！

programme.title: 東坡家事#15粵
programme.desc: 月娥鼓勵閏之離家出走要東坡認錯。安石、東坡為政見針鋒相對，少游竟支持安石。大妹稱時嘔吐且暈倒，原來懷有身孕。東坡與安石再為政策爭吵，皇上命群臣明早入宮表決，多位大臣疑因喝了閏之所釀蜂蜜酒而腹瀉缺席……

programme.title: 高朋滿座#153粵
programme.desc: 溢被送入院，只是皮外傷。Sugar頸傷要戴頸箍，更指是溢所害。高家眾人指責他，令溢百詞莫辯。溢夢見小時候曾將紮孖辮的女同學推落樓梯，令她從此失蹤。Sugar到高家藥房求診，被情發現她有張紮孖辮的照片。

programme.title: 命轉皇后#28粵普PG
programme.desc: 平南王最終死於雪寧刀下。動亂已平，聖上對謝危和燕家軍讚賞有加，派張遮前往瑀州行賞；薛國公知悉此事，心中盤算如何對付謝危。謝危知道雪寧隱瞞與張遮見面一事，為此生氣不已，並對雪寧強調她是屬於自己的。

programme.title: 瘋狂歷史補習社粵
programme.desc: 鍾景輝請來中國史上「頭號暴君」秦始皇，與一班九十後瘋狂學生面對面上中史課！陶傑、游清源、王晶還會分析秦始皇的霸氣是如何練成的。「CID」穿梭時空，查辦大貪官和珅，了解這位憑「貪」而名留千古的經典人物。

programme.title: 瘋狂歷史補習社粵
programme.desc: 古明華飾演嬴政，大爆與呂不韋、李斯的愛恨關係，以及教大家如何統一中國！「史訊」主持「大鑊密探凌凌一」回到南宋時代，查明岳飛的身分，案件重演身為農婦的岳母如何用繡花針，為兒子刺上「精忠報國」四字。

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
沿著運河看中國粵英
programme.desc: 歷史學家Andrew Field將帶領觀眾沿著蘊含豐富歷史文化和精湛工程技術的中國大運河一路前行，在充滿活力的城市裡體驗，並探索這一古老航道如何成為21世紀的奇蹟。

programme.title: 手匠傳承粵韓
programme.desc: 本節目將帶您走進亞洲文化的手工藝術世界，彰顯不同國家的美學。工匠們用心地透過藝術和耐心的加工，創造出了精工細作的文化遺產。工藝及其藝術表現形式作為傳統文化的遺產，為文化多樣性提供了豐富的內容。

programme.title: 世界獨特社區粵普
programme.desc: 波蘭蘇洛斯佐瓦村鎮, 從高處鳥瞰，人們沿著一條街道居住 是村裡唯一的街道，由一位波蘭貴族軍官在16世紀建立。越南順化市的安邦，村民把一生的時間和精力花費在修建巨大奢華的墳墓。生人與死者共用一片天地。

programme.title: 仨心友行 3粵
programme.desc: 三位女主持重拾捉迷藏樂趣，嘉賓陳山聰甫抵莊園即要執行捉人任務。具身高弱點的穎鏇最快被發現，有人躲在同一位置卻可逃過一劫……激烈遊戲過後，以靜態活動調節身心，四人隨銅鑼聲樂手探尋心靈之旅。回想入行路，美恩提到以嘉賓身分，見證師妹穎鏇獲港姐亞軍。模特兒出身的佳芯，自言不是女神？山聰入行近三十年，憶述與劉德華結緣的夢幻經歷。假設當初沒進演藝圈，各人的第二人生又會是怎樣？倒水不瀉挑戰，有女神形象崩壞了……

programme.title: 豪遊咖啡粵
programme.desc: 每逢十二月，尖沙咀都充滿聖誕氣氛，Ben找到彩色聖誕老人圖案拉花的咖啡，究竟是怎樣做到？Mo親自沖泡兩杯讓人甜入心的咖啡，也切合佳節氛圍。二人在紐西蘭主題咖啡店碰頭，Ben為拍檔點喝加入了紐西蘭蜜糖的愛爾蘭咖啡，Mo是否滿意？位於炮台街的咖啡店，則選用金獎咖啡豆沖製鮮奶咖啡，味道略帶花香。嘉賓黃翠如稱學懂品味咖啡只因Ben，她還嘗試拉花，更自誇成品是一幅風景畫？此外，Mo會帶來咖啡豆烘焙學問。

programme.title: 周六聊Teen谷粵
programme.desc: 谷主凱婷提到「情緒價值」一詞源於體驗經濟，原意是企業為顧客打造難忘、獨特的消費體驗，她更以自己購買冰鮮三文魚公仔的經歷為例子。不過，這詞現已延伸至人際關係層面，汛文覺得跟MBTI熱潮相關，何出此言？凱婷又談及現時AI普及，成為方便提供滿滿情緒價值的途徑之一。汛文自言早前經歷情緒低潮，也透過與AI交流而恢復心情。然而，凱婷亦提出爭議一說。有人認為情緒價值令人際關係變得功利化、計價化，眾谷主有何看法？

programme.title: 開心大綜藝之暑假玩到盡粵
programme.desc: 藝人最重要守時，參與今集節目更為重要，因為準時有早餐獎賞，遲到需被懲罰！不過，TVB充滿人情味，「新丁」何依婷的眼淚，是最好的求情理由。先來開口中，林秀怡成為不幸之人，翟威廉則因「勇敢」中招遭噴面。轉玩水上籃球，邵珮詩兩度偷步，共玩了三次滑梯，朱智賢卻臨陣退縮未敢滑下來！「日落西山下」，伍禮騫犯錯連連，連笑一下都是錯！遊戲「極速搶爆波」也會再度登場，威廉再一次展示「豬隊友」特質，令隊員們要求轉隊！

programme.title: 尋找世界另一個我 台灣篇粵
programme.desc: 陳展鵬(煎Pan)相信，名字寄託了父親對自己的期望，也希望往後被叫喚時，讓這個名字更富意義。抵達台北，節目組竟要求煎Pan透過和VTuber聊天來尋人，登上網吧打開門竟見到一名Cosplay女生？參觀過動漫迷陳展鵬擺滿漫畫、模型的房間，煎Pan決定助其改變自己，先從髮型、衣著入手添自信，再為他安排首次跟異性單獨吃一頓飯！飯局換來尷尬情境，翌日，煎Pan要以唱歌接句形式找出另一個陳展鵬，同樣尷尬……

programme.title: 尋找世界另一個我 台灣篇粵
programme.desc: 在燒烤店工作的「台灣陳展鵬」，相約煎Pan往海邊釣魚，哪知兩人的另一半正在「偷聽」男伴訴心聲，煎Pan太太單文柔更聽得淚水狂滴。以為驚喜完畢？原來大家還有一個更大的驚喜，將於放天燈時獻給某人！香港陳展鵬拍過不少動作戲，兩位台灣陳展鵬卻都是畏高一族。煎pan於是策劃練膽任務，要二人跳笨豬跳！有人嚇到連叫都叫不出聲？延續大膽活動，陳展鵬s在西門町一試busking滋味，原來身為歌手的煎pan也會緊張！

programme.title: 地球大神秘粵
programme.desc: 今年是人類充滿惶恐不安的一年，網絡上流傳不少大災難的預言：中東戰火、日本超級大地震等，我們的明天究竟會怎樣呢？很多人想預知未來，研究它的真假，在網絡資訊爆炸的時代，越講越真，越知道反而越驚，就好像聖經一早預言：『人想起將要臨到世界的事，就嚇得魂不附體』這一刻，站在文明懸崖上的我們，是否正要見證這古老預言成為現實？在全新一輯的地球大神秘，我們會繼續從世界各地神秘事件，探討各種預言的真確，還會同被稱為最準確重要的預言書《聖經》作對比，在末世中得到真正的平安保障。

programme.title: 魔神創造傳粵日
programme.desc: 地圖出現七彩方塊的反應，但龍龍看過位置後卻反應消極，去到目的地後發現鳳凰使者紅紅在四處道歉，村民卻避之則吉。大家從其口中得知此處曾經有一所神明幼稚園，龍龍昔日更做過必須道歉的錯事。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 每人都準備好一個已充氣的氣球，就開始這次「WORKOUT 2GETHER」。先做五個與協調能力有關的訓練，抬腿並於胯下換手取氣球，又試試改半蹲姿勢，在胯下「8」字運球。二人一組以背部夾着氣球，同時把另一個氣球傳給對方，亦講求合作度。接下來的五個動作則有助強化專注及平衡能力，大腿夾着氣球，再踮腳走直線，做到嗎？放手讓氣球下墜，雙腿同時蹲下去接球。單腳站立，還要輪流利用手背、手掌拍起氣球，也非易事！

programme.title: 查查林部隊粵英
programme.desc: 森林裡神秘怪事頻生。巨大陷阱出現，栗子消失，昆蟲失蹤，橡實從天而降！要交由大偵探Peet和朋友Baba和Molly組成的查查林部隊調查。牠們未必是最能幹的偵探隊，但往往能夠迎刃而解，揭開大自然奧秘。

programme.title: 查查林部隊粵英
programme.desc: 森林裡神秘怪事頻生。巨大陷阱出現，栗子消失，昆蟲失蹤，橡實從天而降！要交由大偵探Peet和朋友Baba和Molly組成的查查林部隊調查。牠們未必是最能幹的偵探隊，但往往能夠迎刃而解，揭開大自然奧秘。

programme.title: 安妮的童話粵日
programme.desc: 安妮與朋友扮演伊萊恩公主的故事，但小船漏水沉沒，安妮獲基爾伯特拯救，卻堅持不願跟對方和好。有傳聞指史黛絲會回去家鄉教書，史黛絲在班上澄清自己會留下，此情此景令安妮決心要成為教師。

programme.title: 野性四季：珍稀野生動物在中國粵
programme.desc: 《野性四季：珍稀野生動物在中國》聯合世界頂尖野生動物拍攝團隊，透過以年為週期的野外追蹤拍攝，為動物國寶留存具有歷史意義和科學價值的珍貴影像檔案。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
新聞透視粵
programme.desc: 《新聞透視》，每周專題報道多段香港以至國際的矚目新聞，聚焦港人最關心的民生話題，並邀請各界人士、學者、專家，一同深入探討箇中來龍去脈。

programme.title: 好嘢港多啲粵
programme.desc: 香港特區政府帶領各個部門及單位，適時推出不同的政策措施，為本港市民、到訪旅客、來自外地的投資者提供便捷服務。香港這麼好，當然要多說一些讓大家知道。《好嘢港多啲》以輕鬆有趣的拍攝手法，配合陳豪、高海寧、張振朗、劉佩玥、周嘉洛、羅子溢、馬國明、陳懿德、陳展鵬、劉穎鏇等一眾星級藝員，透過不同角色、形象，生動地表達香港的各樣美好和優勢。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 渣打夥拍保誠攜手傳承：家傳之「保」2粵
programme.desc: 劉穎鏇能夠自信追夢，全靠父母百分百支持，劉爸爸還為女兒學煮住家飯。穎鏇藉洗頭、染髮答謝曾任髮型師的爸爸，卻遭嫌棄吹頭手勢？回望港姐面試前一度退縮，幸得爸爸鼓勵永不放棄，才可勇往直前。港姐蛻變打女，穎鏇堅毅精神亦令《奪命提示》拍檔張振朗讚佩，二人練拳兼談合作點滴。劉爸爸自言是女兒超級粉絲，能否通過劇照大考驗？穎鏇偕爸爸重拾粉麵老店的滋味，還親自做手錶凝聚一家三口的愛，連線身在美國的媽媽一幕甚是動人！

programme.title: AlipayHK 呈獻：唱錢粵
programme.desc: 音準、拍子大考驗，唱歌隨時有錢落袋！婚禮樂隊主唱煲仔演唱情歌經驗豐富，還曾於機緣下獲「師兄」劉浩龍指點歌藝？音樂中心創辦人兼鋼琴與聲樂導師Connie親身上陣，教學生勇於接受挑戰！兩位素人參賽者以征服Sing盤上不同歌曲難度「過三關」，甚至是最難的Monster關卡，向打爆九宮格的目標進發。觀眾只需用手機掃描螢幕上的QR Code，即可參與直播室互動，為挑戰者打氣，更有機會贏取福利。

programme.title: 伯樂音樂學院20週年呈獻：J Music粵
programme.desc: 《J Music》致力打造高質音樂平台，一眾歌手有展示音樂實力的機會之餘，也可讓樂迷更深入了解歌手的音樂故事。節目邀請「人氣」歌手擔任嘉賓，由嘉賓親自挑選其喜歡的新舊作品，並即場演唱，分享喜愛曲目。而一些樂壇新面孔亦會亮相，透過互動交流，展現音樂潛力。此外，每集緊貼「勁歌金榜」最新形勢，還會帶來不同歌手、創作人或製作人的訪問，跟觀眾暢談作品，以至音樂業界的人和事。

programme.title: 美食新聞周報粵
programme.desc: 行仔相約「星級飯腳」梅小惠開餐。蔥肉小煎包一咬爆汁，「大堆頭」海鮮鍋香辣惹味。胡美貽駕車載廖慧儀到油麻地享用麻辣雞煲，雞肉鮮嫩入味；還有麻而不辣的涼拌花甲，鮮甜爽口。食評家KC則帶波波品嚐港式粉麵店的地道美食，包括牛筋腩河及炸魚片頭，並示範推薦吃法。陳國強師傅推介吉隆坡「人氣」中菜餐廳，享用以頂級愛爾蘭烤鴨炮製的當歸薑蔥爆烤鴨肉、煙燻櫻桃木烤鴨腿，以及鋪上魚子醬的片皮鴨多士，油香濃郁，皮脆肉嫩。

programme.title: 香港賽馬會特約：J Sport粵
programme.desc: 科技結合運動衍生競技新趨勢，港將關竣仁曾奪世運會無人機競速銀牌，他細談箇中熱愛；無人機足球亦推廣到中學校園，有何吸引之處？世界劍擊錦標賽，港隊花劍男團歷史性摘銀，還會總結港將表現。手球紫荊盃設U6、U8、U10組別，召集香港與內地隊伍參與，推動手球發展。空手道前代表蔡韻瑜轉型體育行政工作、前港足陳靜謙從事學校推廣，這集檢視退役運動員的第二舞台。另帶來高級組銀牌籃球賽、街舞大賽香港區決賽的比拼精華。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
廉政狙擊#18粵PG
programme.desc: 韋繼明被上司召見，斥責他私自調查尹在詩案。章Sir命令子峰暗中調查幾個廉政公署高層，找出誰是勾結卓廷光的內鬼Martin。卓日升酒後傷人，遺下兇器，卓以凡以莊慕雪被性侵的不雅照片要脅韋繼明換走兇器。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 豪遊咖啡粵
programme.desc: 每逢十二月，尖沙咀都充滿聖誕氣氛，Ben找到彩色聖誕老人圖案拉花的咖啡，究竟是怎樣做到？Mo親自沖泡兩杯讓人甜入心的咖啡，也切合佳節氛圍。二人在紐西蘭主題咖啡店碰頭，Ben為拍檔點喝加入了紐西蘭蜜糖的愛爾蘭咖啡，Mo是否滿意？位於炮台街的咖啡店，則選用金獎咖啡豆沖製鮮奶咖啡，味道略帶花香。嘉賓黃翠如稱學懂品味咖啡只因Ben，她還嘗試拉花，更自誇成品是一幅風景畫？此外，Mo會帶來咖啡豆烘焙學問。

programme.title: 周六聊Teen谷粵
programme.desc: 谷主凱婷提到「情緒價值」一詞源於體驗經濟，原意是企業為顧客打造難忘、獨特的消費體驗，她更以自己購買冰鮮三文魚公仔的經歷為例子。不過，這詞現已延伸至人際關係層面，汛文覺得跟MBTI熱潮相關，何出此言？凱婷又談及現時AI普及，成為方便提供滿滿情緒價值的途徑之一。汛文自言早前經歷情緒低潮，也透過與AI交流而恢復心情。然而，凱婷亦提出爭議一說。有人認為情緒價值令人際關係變得功利化、計價化，眾谷主有何看法？

programme.title: 仨心友行 3粵
programme.desc: 三位女主持重拾捉迷藏樂趣，嘉賓陳山聰甫抵莊園即要執行捉人任務。具身高弱點的穎鏇最快被發現，有人躲在同一位置卻可逃過一劫……激烈遊戲過後，以靜態活動調節身心，四人隨銅鑼聲樂手探尋心靈之旅。回想入行路，美恩提到以嘉賓身分，見證師妹穎鏇獲港姐亞軍。模特兒出身的佳芯，自言不是女神？山聰入行近三十年，憶述與劉德華結緣的夢幻經歷。假設當初沒進演藝圈，各人的第二人生又會是怎樣？倒水不瀉挑戰，有女神形象崩壞了……

programme.title: 尋找世界另一個我 台灣篇粵
programme.desc: 陳展鵬(煎Pan)相信，名字寄託了父親對自己的期望，也希望往後被叫喚時，讓這個名字更富意義。抵達台北，節目組竟要求煎Pan透過和VTuber聊天來尋人，登上網吧打開門竟見到一名Cosplay女生？參觀過動漫迷陳展鵬擺滿漫畫、模型的房間，煎Pan決定助其改變自己，先從髮型、衣著入手添自信，再為他安排首次跟異性單獨吃一頓飯！飯局換來尷尬情境，翌日，煎Pan要以唱歌接句形式找出另一個陳展鵬，同樣尷尬……

programme.title: 尋找世界另一個我 台灣篇粵
programme.desc: 在燒烤店工作的「台灣陳展鵬」，相約煎Pan往海邊釣魚，哪知兩人的另一半正在「偷聽」男伴訴心聲，煎Pan太太單文柔更聽得淚水狂滴。以為驚喜完畢？原來大家還有一個更大的驚喜，將於放天燈時獻給某人！香港陳展鵬拍過不少動作戲，兩位台灣陳展鵬卻都是畏高一族。煎pan於是策劃練膽任務，要二人跳笨豬跳！有人嚇到連叫都叫不出聲？延續大膽活動，陳展鵬s在西門町一試busking滋味，原來身為歌手的煎pan也會緊張！

programme.title: 手匠傳承粵韓
programme.desc: 本節目將帶您走進亞洲文化的手工藝術世界，彰顯不同國家的美學。工匠們用心地透過藝術和耐心的加工，創造出了精工細作的文化遺產。工藝及其藝術表現形式作為傳統文化的遺產，為文化多樣性提供了豐富的內容。

programme.title: 世界獨特社區粵普
programme.desc: 波蘭蘇洛斯佐瓦村鎮, 從高處鳥瞰，人們沿著一條街道居住 是村裡唯一的街道，由一位波蘭貴族軍官在16世紀建立。越南順化市的安邦，村民把一生的時間和精力花費在修建巨大奢華的墳墓。生人與死者共用一片天地。

programme.title: 沿著運河看中國粵英
programme.desc: 歷史學家Andrew Field將帶領觀眾沿著蘊含豐富歷史文化和精湛工程技術的中國大運河一路前行，在充滿活力的城市裡體驗，並探索這一古老航道如何成為21世紀的奇蹟。

programme.title: 王國戰隊
programme.desc: 頻繁的地震導致各地災情不斷，五大王國決定召集各國的動物英雄－－狼群守護者路卡、熊群保護者諾文、猿猴守望者狄萊拉、獾群守護者提傑，以及貓群守護者米特絲，組成「王國戰隊」！習慣獨自戰鬥的英雄們，不得不學習互相合作，共同守護彼此重視的家園。然而米特絲拒絕加入戰隊，小助手賈巴利自告奮勇，與頂尖英雄們一起作戰！

programme.title: 我們，家
programme.desc: 【金喜善陷入家庭危機！神秘女子揭露家族秘密】心理學博士兼知名人物英媛與家人過著幸福生活，直到神秘女子世娜的出現引發連鎖事件。公公意外身亡，丈夫在振與世娜失蹤，揭露他們的不倫關係。在尋找丈夫的過程中，英媛發現世娜是心理變態，曾殺死三個前夫。同時，兒子道賢也坦承與學校前輩素伊有了孩子。家庭的秘密逐漸浮出水面，英媛必須面對現實，守護家人並解開所有的謎團。

programme.title: 陷入純情
programme.desc: 【浪漫速成鄭敬淏愛與復仇的心臟奇蹟】沒血沒淚的冷酷企業代表姜敏浩，有著先天擴張性心藏病，面對隨時有可能死亡的恐懼感，做起事來比誰都還心狠手辣。幼年父親去世時，叔叔奪走了父親的公司，高層主管們也紛紛選擇背叛，龐大壓力下母親選擇輕生留下敏浩一人。復仇心的驅使下，他成為GoldPartners的投資專家，同時也是叔叔公司Hermia的最大債權人團體，看似成功之際，卻心臟病發命在旦夕，所幸出現心臟捐贈者，重生的他因細胞記憶而變得溫暖，甚至對仇人女兒產生微妙的情感，重拾幸福的療癒愛情故事。

programme.title: 燦爛的遺產
programme.desc: 【李昇基、韓孝珠經典代表作！灰姑娘逆襲無賴王子】高恩星在母親因病去世後，從此多了一個沒有血緣關係的妹妹柳承美。繼母城府極深，表面上對恩星姐弟關愛有加，但卻是個非常愛錢的女人。恩星的父親公司破產，且不慎遭搶劫，搶匪戴著他的物品在火災中喪生。繼母誤認死者為丈夫，領取巨額保險金後將恩星姊弟趕出門。恩星偶然救了食品公司社長張淑子，而得到工作，然而張淑子竟然說要把財產全留給恩星，還說要切斷金孫于煥所有的經濟來源。為了逆轉這種情況，于煥只好跟仇人般的恩星一起工作，卻發現自己逐漸喜歡上恩星。

programme.title: 不像三兄弟
programme.desc: 【李浚赫化身金家小兒子婆媳兵團VS警察家族笑料不斷！】聚焦警察爸爸金巡警的三個兒子，廢柴長子安內相被期待壓垮，一事無成卻偷偷戀上單親媽媽；事業型二哥吳大奎功成名就，卻被夾在母親偏心與妻子不滿之間，婚姻岌岌可危；理想派小兒子李浚赫剛當警察，卻愛上了脾氣火爆的富家女。兄弟情誼充滿矛盾和心結，當愛情遭遇現實考驗，婆媳摩擦與婚姻裂痕不斷升級，這個家不再是避風港，而是情緒的火藥庫。笑中帶淚的家庭日常，揭開最真實又狗血的親情與愛情試煉！

programme.title: 寵妻明君：李祘
programme.desc: 年幼的李祘目睹了父親死於政治陰謀，又在祖父近乎慘酷的調教下長大，雖然貴為王位繼承人，但政敵始終欲治李祘於死地，這些練就了李祘逆境中處變不驚、不折不撓的品性。宮廷畫苑的畫師韓松淵是李祘的紅粉知己。後來松淵做了李祘的王妃，一直堅定地支持着李祘的治國大業。

programme.title: 不像三兄弟
programme.desc: 【李浚赫化身金家小兒子婆媳兵團VS警察家族笑料不斷！】聚焦警察爸爸金巡警的三個兒子，廢柴長子安內相被期待壓垮，一事無成卻偷偷戀上單親媽媽；事業型二哥吳大奎功成名就，卻被夾在母親偏心與妻子不滿之間，婚姻岌岌可危；理想派小兒子李浚赫剛當警察，卻愛上了脾氣火爆的富家女。兄弟情誼充滿矛盾和心結，當愛情遭遇現實考驗，婆媳摩擦與婚姻裂痕不斷升級，這個家不再是避風港，而是情緒的火藥庫。笑中帶淚的家庭日常，揭開最真實又狗血的親情與愛情試煉！

programme.title: 好搭檔(完)
programme.desc: 【張娜拉火力全開！槓上小三、手撕出軌老公超過癮】王牌律師遇上菜鳥新人，一場法庭與情感的雙重對決即將展開！《好搭檔》講述擁有17年經驗的離婚律師車恩京，在面對丈夫背叛後，與熱血正義的新人韓宥利成為「最不可能搭檔」的辦公室火花組合。冷面魔頭與理想主義者，兩人從互看不順眼，到聯手應對一樁樁離婚官司，解開婚姻背後的人性兩難。冷靜與熱血交織，掀起一場場心碎又痛快的離婚風暴！

programme.desc: 【李昇基、韓孝珠經典代表作！灰姑娘逆襲無賴王子】高恩星在母親因病去世後，從此多了一個沒有血緣關係的妹妹柳承美。繼母城府極深，表面上對恩星姐弟關愛有加，但卻是個非常愛錢的女人。恩星的父親公司破產，且不慎遭搶劫，搶匪戴著他的物品在火災中喪生。繼母誤認死者為丈夫，領取巨額保險金後將恩星姊弟趕出門。恩星偶然救了食品公司社長張淑子，而得到工作，然而張淑子竟然說要把財產全留給恩星，還說要切斷金孫于煥所有的經濟來源。為了逆轉這種情況，于煥只好跟仇人般的恩星一起工作，卻發現自己逐漸喜歡上恩星。

programme.title: 不像三兄弟
programme.desc: 【李浚赫化身金家小兒子婆媳兵團VS警察家族笑料不斷！】聚焦警察爸爸金巡警的三個兒子，廢柴長子安內相被期待壓垮，一事無成卻偷偷戀上單親媽媽；事業型二哥吳大奎功成名就，卻被夾在母親偏心與妻子不滿之間，婚姻岌岌可危；理想派小兒子李浚赫剛當警察，卻愛上了脾氣火爆的富家女。兄弟情誼充滿矛盾和心結，當愛情遭遇現實考驗，婆媳摩擦與婚姻裂痕不斷升級，這個家不再是避風港，而是情緒的火藥庫。笑中帶淚的家庭日常，揭開最真實又狗血的親情與愛情試煉！

programme.title: 陷入純情
programme.desc: 【浪漫速成鄭敬淏愛與復仇的心臟奇蹟】沒血沒淚的冷酷企業代表姜敏浩，有著先天擴張性心藏病，面對隨時有可能死亡的恐懼感，做起事來比誰都還心狠手辣。幼年父親去世時，叔叔奪走了父親的公司，高層主管們也紛紛選擇背叛，龐大壓力下母親選擇輕生留下敏浩一人。復仇心的驅使下，他成為GoldPartners的投資專家，同時也是叔叔公司Hermia的最大債權人團體，看似成功之際，卻心臟病發命在旦夕，所幸出現心臟捐贈者，重生的他因細胞記憶而變得溫暖，甚至對仇人女兒產生微妙的情感，重拾幸福的療癒愛情故事。

programme.title: 寵妻明君：李祘
programme.desc: 年幼的李祘目睹了父親死於政治陰謀，又在祖父近乎慘酷的調教下長大，雖然貴為王位繼承人，但政敵始終欲治李祘於死地，這些練就了李祘逆境中處變不驚、不折不撓的品性。宮廷畫苑的畫師韓松淵是李祘的紅粉知己。後來松淵做了李祘的王妃，一直堅定地支持着李祘的治國大業。

programme.title: 現在開始是Showtime！
programme.desc: 【操縱幻術的魔術師朴海鎮×通靈女警秦基周，靈異喜劇Showtime！！】神秘又搞怪的魔術師車次雄，不僅能操縱幻術，還能使喚鬼魂，這群「幽靈助手」是他的得力夥伴。熱血女警高瑟海，擁有通靈能力，她對靈異現象毫不畏懼。兩人因一起調查超自然案件而結盟，一邊與鬼神合作，一邊大展魔術與正義力量。當喜劇、靈異與調查結合，愛情與真相也心動牽引。

programme.title: 九尾狐傳
programme.desc: 【人間九尾狐李棟旭苦等初戀大談人狐千年禁忌戀！！】活在現代的九尾狐李硯，身兼著閻羅王姐姐的陰間使者指令，斬妖除魔苦苦等候初戀南智雅轉世千年在今生相遇，做為半人半妖的同父異母弟弟李朗，頻頻與李硯作對攪局。過去親情、愛情、友情的磨難及錯誤的種子，在此世會得到解答嗎?

programme.title: 韶華若錦
programme.desc: 【宋威龍x包上恩，甜到掉牙先婚後愛的夫妻生活！！】冷面戰神定北王江緒因調查北軍軍餉貪墨案回到大顯王朝，沒想到貪墨案背後牽連甚廣，為了盡快查明真相，他自願迎娶將門之女明檀，讓明家免遭利用。兩人先婚後愛，相處過程中逐漸產生情愫，並且聯手揭露朝堂陰謀，經歷坎坷後雙向收穫的美好愛情。

programme.title: 呱張爆音團
programme.desc: 12歲的柯阿瑞和他的三個好朋友一起在車庫裡成立了一支樂隊，但是很快的他們就發現他們的樂隊很爛-真的很爛。問題不在他們的音樂或是百變造型，而是因為柯阿瑞寫不出歌詞。他就是想不出酷炫的歌詞嘛，直到......柯阿瑞找到了他姊姊翠娜的日記。「哇！這裡面不只廢話連篇，還有滿滿的青少年煩惱。」柯阿瑞和樂隊「秘密的」用翠娜最新的日記作為他們的創作新曲的歌詞–結果你知道怎麼樣嗎？效果真是棒到要大叫嗷嗷嗷，當然演出機會也越來越多了！這樣一來就皆大歡喜了，對嗎？才怪。翠娜是個超級討人厭的恰查某，完全無法忍受她弟弟的爛樂隊比她還要紅。她想盡辦法要來粉碎他們的夢想。但沒關係啦。柯阿瑞很瞭解他姊姊，嗯...就像姊姊肚子裡的蛔蟲一樣。柯阿瑞總是知道該怎麼做才能讓翠娜炸毛，然後生出他們最欠缺的東西......歌詞！快跟著柯阿瑞和他的樂團嗨翻天吧！看他們為達目的怎麼不擇手段的惡搞翠娜的玻璃心世界吧！

programme.title: 呱張爆音團
programme.desc: 12歲的柯阿瑞和他的三個好朋友一起在車庫裡成立了一支樂隊，但是很快的他們就發現他們的樂隊很爛-真的很爛。問題不在他們的音樂或是百變造型，而是因為柯阿瑞寫不出歌詞。他就是想不出酷炫的歌詞嘛，直到......柯阿瑞找到了他姊姊翠娜的日記。「哇！這裡面不只廢話連篇，還有滿滿的青少年煩惱。」柯阿瑞和樂隊「秘密的」用翠娜最新的日記作為他們的創作新曲的歌詞–結果你知道怎麼樣嗎？效果真是棒到要大叫嗷嗷嗷，當然演出機會也越來越多了！這樣一來就皆大歡喜了，對嗎？才怪。翠娜是個超級討人厭的恰查某，完全無法忍受她弟弟的爛樂隊比她還要紅。她想盡辦法要來粉碎他們的夢想。但沒關係啦。柯阿瑞很瞭解他姊姊，嗯...就像姊姊肚子裡的蛔蟲一樣。柯阿瑞總是知道該怎麼做才能讓翠娜炸毛，然後生出他們最欠缺的東西......歌詞！快跟著柯阿瑞和他的樂團嗨翻天吧！看他們為達目的怎麼不擇手段的惡搞翠娜的玻璃心世界吧！

programme.desc: 12歲的柯阿瑞和他的三個好朋友一起在車庫裡成立了一支樂隊，但是很快的他們就發現他們的樂隊很爛-真的很爛。問題不在他們的音樂或是百變造型，而是因為柯阿瑞寫不出歌詞。他就是想不出酷炫的歌詞嘛，直到......柯阿瑞找到了他姊姊翠娜的日記。「哇！這裡面不只廢話連篇，還有滿滿的青少年煩惱。」柯阿瑞和樂隊「秘密的」用翠娜最新的日記作為他們的創作新曲的歌詞–結果你知道怎麼樣嗎？效果真是棒到要大叫嗷嗷嗷，當然演出機會也越來越多了！這樣一來就皆大歡喜了，對嗎？才怪。翠娜是個超級討人厭的恰查某，完全無法忍受她弟弟的爛樂隊比她還要紅。她想盡辦法要來粉碎他們的夢想。但沒關係啦。柯阿瑞很瞭解他姊姊，嗯...就像姊姊肚子裡的蛔蟲一樣。柯阿瑞總是知道該怎麼做才能讓翠娜炸毛，然後生出他們最欠缺的東西......歌詞！快跟著柯阿瑞和他的樂團嗨翻天吧！看他們為達目的怎麼不擇手段的惡搞翠娜的玻璃心世界吧！

programme.title: 粉紅色口紅
programme.desc: 【朴恩惠經典復仇之作好閨密為渣男反目成仇】因做錯抉擇導致人生本末倒置的女人，經過4次婚姻終於找到真愛與幸福的故事。柳佳恩把初戀情人當成全部，放棄了自己的夢想，卻得到徹頭徹尾的背叛。她的第一任丈夫朴正宇，圖謀佳恩家的財富和地位與佳恩結婚，在達到目的後將佳恩拋棄，轉而和情人美蘭結婚，陰謀奪得了佳恩父親的公司，並間接害死了佳恩的父親。在如此深仇大恨面前，佳恩一步步從一位百合般純潔的女人，變成了帶刺的玫瑰。

programme.title: 沒關係，是一家人
programme.desc: 【母親宣布「卒婚」引發家庭風暴父親失憶揭露大女兒身世秘密】故事圍繞著一對老年夫婦和他們的三名成年子女展開。母親突然宣佈要「卒婚」，因厭倦與脾氣火爆的父親同居，父親則因委屈一度想輕生，卻失敗導致失憶回到22歲，意外揭露大女兒並非親生的秘密。大女兒恩珠發現丈夫是同性戀，內心崩潰，而二女兒恩熙則陷入了複雜的感情糾葛中，被劈腿後又成了上司的情人。小兒子智宇無意中知曉了家族的深藏秘密。「像外人一樣的家人」間產生誤會，不斷磨合理解的家庭劇。

programme.title: 真愛OnAir
programme.desc: 【金荷娜《Onair》詮釋辛辣女星與編劇、導演、經紀人上演修羅場！】傲氣女星吳升雅外冷內熱，渴望被理解；毒舌編劇徐英恩辛辣犀利，因背叛築起心牆；導演李慶民冷面苛刻，與英恩有難解過往；經紀人張基俊圓融細膩，總在混亂中守住分寸。四人因同一部劇合作，從爭執、碰撞、試探，到逐漸看見彼此的脆弱與真心。升雅卸下武裝、英恩學會柔軟、慶民面對情感、基俊守住信念。他們不只拍戲，更在現場演繹真實人生。

programme.title: 歐若拉公主
programme.desc: 【落難千金嫁到三位「惡婆婆」家，受盡欺辱卻迷的兩位男神團團轉！】該劇以豪爽純潔的愛情故事繼續展開，故事發生在大公司名門之女歐若拉遇見與三個姐姐一起生活的完美但挑剔的小說家黃瑪瑪。

programme.title: 名人初乃玩
programme.desc: 最接地氣的外景行腳節目,由名人帶領網路紅人到店家體驗吃、喝、玩、樂。寓教於樂，帶給觀眾耳目一新的超強體驗。

programme.title: 向風而行
programme.desc: 【《請叫我總監》譚松韻與《清平樂》王凱，飛向天際攜手築夢！！】鷺洲航空客運飛行部副部長顧南亭因公司改制，與性格颯爽不羈的程霄成為上下屬和師徒關係。面對接踵而來的突發航空事件，追求穩定秩序的顧南亭時常被不按常理出牌的程霄打亂計劃，共同經歷衝擊與考驗，一路披荊斬棘、相扶成長。

programme.title: 落花時節又逢君
programme.desc: 【小花妖胡意旋強撩告白高冷花神劉學義，大談反差萌戀！！】不懂情愛、呆萌率直的小花妖紅凝，為了報恩誤闖仙界，卻意外發現自己口中的「仙女姐姐」，竟是身為花神的錦繡。紅凝大膽示愛，直言想當錦繡的「天后」，不是拉著他一起睡覺就是要陪他洗澡，讓這位必須斷情絕愛、恪守仙妖界限的未來天帝繼承者瞬間亂了方寸。

programme.title: 步步驚心
programme.desc: 那一天，張曉的命運被一場車禍徹底改寫。她眼看著那輛失控的卡車將自己的靈魂撞出了軀體，而她，既沒有進醫院也沒有進天堂，卻是被撞進了清朝的宮廷中。就像鋪天蓋地的穿越小說裏寫的那樣，張曉的靈魂跨過時間的隧道，在一個叫馬爾泰.若曦的十六歲清朝女孩的體內，重生了…時年，康熙第四十三。天下太平，但一場震動歷史的「九龍奪嫡」正在暗潮湧動。權利的廝殺，愛情的灼燒，在被無限放大的歷史舞臺上，張曉，不，是馬爾泰•若曦的命運無可避免的與眾位親王阿哥們交織在一起…她知道自己不該捲入這場九王奪嫡的爭鬥中，可心不由己，因為這裡有她所愛的，也有愛著她的…若曦最後選擇的究竟是溫潤如玉的八阿哥，還是面冷心熱的四阿哥，又或是出人意料的其他人?等歷史的風雲過後，可以陪她看夕陽西下、雲捲雲舒的又將是誰？

programme.title: 金裝律師
programme.desc: 【改編人氣美國影集，張東健×朴炯植聯手成為法律界黃金拍檔！！】頭腦聰明，擁有過目不忘天才能力的高延宇，卻因家境關係卻步成為律師。混進了律師事務所遇上韓國頂級資深律師崔江錫。隨著事件發生與時間相處成為黃金拍檔，崔江錫要如何亦師亦友的帶著沒有正式唸過大學也只是菜鳥律師的高延宇打出一片天下呢？

programme.title: 雙軌
programme.desc: 【何與×虞書欣偽骨科繼兄妹禁忌愛戀，從愛妹到曖昧火花四射！！】姜暮9歲前是被家人寵在手心的小女孩，靳朝是天之驕子的哥哥。那年父母離婚，兩人命運自此走上雙軌，爸爸和哥哥移居泰國，成為地下賽車與拳場中的修車工。多年後，19歲的姜暮得知哥哥是被領養的秘密，瞞著所有人獨自飛往泰國。在泰國的租屋中兩人展開了一段隱秘而甜蜜的情感旅程，在光明與黑暗間重逢，禁忌拉扯中雙向救贖。

programme.desc: 【改編人氣美國影集，張東健×朴炯植聯手成為法律界黃金拍檔！！】頭腦聰明，擁有過目不忘天才能力的高延宇，卻因家境關係卻步成為律師。混進了律師事務所遇上韓國頂級資深律師崔江錫。隨著事件發生與時間相處成為黃金拍檔，崔江錫要如何亦師亦友的帶著沒有正式唸過大學也只是菜鳥律師的高延宇打出一片天下呢？

programme.desc: Hyundai Cup 2026 is the 16th ASEAN Championship, the biennial international men's football championship of Southeast Asia organised by the ASEAN Football Federation (AFF) and will be the 1st edition under the name ASEAN Hyundai Cup. The tournament will celebrate as the 30th anniversary of the competition. The event will start on 24 July till 26 August 2026. Vietnam are the defending champions after winning the 2024 final against Thailand. Catch the heated tournaments where 10 qualified teams are split into two groups of five and play a round robin system, with each team playing four fixtures. The format of the knockout round remains unchanged, with semi-finals and the final played on two-leg format.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - OCTO-DANCE! ROOKIE AND THE OCTOPUS
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting on the shore, enjoying the sun, when he sees something repeatedly poking out of the water, sparking his curiosity. He puts on his underwater robot mask and dives into the ocean. At first, all he finds are rocks and coral, but suddenly, big, round eyes are staring at him from a gray rock. He flees in panic, but when he realizes that it is an octopus whose tentacles are tangled in plastic waste, he quickly frees his new friend from this unpleasant situation, and they dance happily together in the water

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - GAME ON? ROOKIE AND THE COMPUTER
programme.desc: Rookie comes across an office cubicle with a computer on the table and is immediately fascinated. He presses some keys, a little character appears on the screen, and a computer game starts. Very excited, Rookie continues to press different keys. When in the end he wins the race and earns a trophy, the computer suddenly takes Rookie‘s photo and prints it out. However, the printing doesn‘t stop, and soon the whole floor is covered with photos before Rookie finally manages to shut down the computer and stop the madness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - LET IT BEEEEE! ROOKIE AND THE BEE
programme.desc: Rookie finds a wooden box, knocks on it, and then shakes it. What a bad idea! The whole swarm of bees chases him, and he has to hide in the bushes. After the swarm is gone, he finds a tired and exhausted bee on the ground. Rookie has the idea to rescue the little bee with a sugar cube. The whole beehive is grateful, and Rookie learns a lot about the work of these useful little friends.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - SNOWBALL EFFECT? ROOKIE AND THE POLAR BEAR
programme.desc: Rookie is happily stomping through the snow when he suddenly gets hit by several snowballs. A pair of cheeky polar bears try to engage him in a playful snowball fight. But Rookie outwits them by hiding in the snow, causing the bears to stumble and then get hit by his surprise robot snowball machine. After the snowy confusion turns to laughter, everyone shares a moment of fun and happiness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - SPRING, SUMMER, FALL & WINTER - ROOKIE AND THE 4 SEASONS
programme.desc: From the window of his house Rookie watches the four seasons pass by and thinks of his friends and the great fun and adventures they had throughout the year: The bees that make everything bloom and the cheeky little ladybug in spring; a day at the beach, snorkeling with friends and a water battle in summer; fl ying kites, fun in the rain and his friend the squirrel getting ready in autumn and building snowmen, snowballs and sledding fun in winter.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - READY, SET, GO! ROOKIE AND THE RABBIT
programme.desc: Rookie is relaxing in the sun when something rushes past him, leaving him in a cloud of dust. Using his telescope, he spots a racing rabbit, and with the tasty prospect of a sweet carrot for the winner, he manages to persuade it to take part in a race. Ready – steady – and off they go: Even though the rabbit stumbles and Rookie has to help, they finish the race together, tumbling happily over the finish line.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BALANCE IN PINK – ROOKIE AND THE FLAMINGO
programme.desc: On his stroll around a lake, Rookie spots a group of pink flamingos gracefully balancing on one leg. Curious, Rookie tries to imitate them and, after practicing a little, manages to do so quite well. But suddenly there‘s a loud splash and Rookie discovers a flamingo struggling to stand on one leg, falling over and over. Offering to help, Rookie comes up with an excellent idea - a pair of roller skates! And there, slowly but surely, the flamingo learns to skate gracefully like a ballerina and to balance on one leg as well.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BOUNCE, REBOUND - SCORE! ROOKIE AND THE GIRAFFE
programme.desc: Rookie is out for a walk on a beautiful day when he suddenly hears a rhythmic sound in the distance. Curious as always, he goes out to investigate and finds a young giraffe playing basketball, skillfully dribbling and bouncing the ball into a basketball hoop high in the trees. Of course, Rookie wants to join in, but he has a few things to learn before their first game. In the end, they impress each other with their skills and tricks.

He visits an egg-shaped dwarf planet that shouldn't really exist, a tiny moon that looks like a UFO, a tortured patchwork moon, and an eerie ocean world in orbit around Jupiter. He also finds out how simple forces have created such bizarre places.

programme.desc: Donal shares more delicious dishes; speedy teriyaki salmon with fluffy rice and greens, comforting herby sausage meatballs with pasta and golden oven baked chicken shawarma flatbreads.

programme.title: Malaysia Gourmet With Justine Schofield S01 - EP7
programme.desc: Justine finds unique tea practices, the world of bees and honey in Sabah and traditional, delicious fish dishes that local chefs make. She then prepares lobak and nasi dagang.

programme.title: Jason Atherton's Dubai Dishes S02 - EP4
programme.desc: Jason visits Dubai's Old Town to get fully immersed in the local culture and cuisine, and Ranvir is out and about as she discovers the importance of Dubai's fragrances.

programme.title: George Clarke's Amazing Spaces S13 - EP5
programme.desc: A life changing camper van for a tetraplegic mum and her son, with cerebral palsy, a deliciously clever build inspired by a cupcake and George visits three eco builds and Portugal's thinnest house.

programme.title: Grand Designs: House of the Year S08 - 2025, Incredible Transformations
programme.desc: In the grand finale, Kevin McCloud explores dramatic re-inventions where barns, bungalows and townhouses are radically transformed. And one home is crowned RIBA House of the Year 2025.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver: Cooking for Less Special S01 - EP1
programme.desc: Jamie Oliver shares his delicious dishes and culinary skills in his cooking show with simple but tasty recipes.

programme.title: Amazing Hotels: Life Beyond the Lobby S05 - Kasbah Tamadot, Morocco
programme.desc: Monica Galetti and Rob Rinder travel to Kasbah Tamadot in the Atlas Mountains of Morocco. With Sir Richard Branson as their boss, they discover how genuine Berber hospitality and spectacular views of the landscape make it unique. Monica helps the chef source local produce at the nearby market and gets to know a very famous visitor, while Rob mucks out the hotel stables and guides guests on a mountain trek.

programme.title: World's Most Luxurious S01 - Private Jets
programme.desc: Luxury travel blogger Em Sheldon catches a flight on one of the most extravagant private jets in the world, which cost more than £80m to build and kit out. The cabin of this jet was designed by leading international designer Edese Doret, who was famously asked to create designs for the US President's aircraft Air Force One, and the blinds, music and cabin temperature can be controlled from iPads tucked into each seat.

programme.title: Jamie: Eat Yourself Healthy S01 - EP3
programme.desc: Jamie makes a super-easy and nutritious seared tuna with tangy kimchi sauce, celebrates fibre-packed overnight oats, and cooks up a nourishingly hearty chicken and mushroom hotpot.

programme.title: Bake Off: The Professionals S08 - EP6

programme.title: DIY SOS S34 - EP1
programme.desc: The team are in Leicester to help seven-year-old Isla, a bright and determined little girl who dreams of living more independently in her own home. Born with a rare genetic condition, Isla requires a fully bespoke environment - from accessible furniture to specially designed living spaces. But creating a home that supports her now and into the future is no small feat. With limited space and a long list of bespoke adaptations, the team face one of their biggest logistical and emotional challenges

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Pizza Girls
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo make mud pizzas and deliver them to the grown-ups, but their pedal car's wheel keeps falling off.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Driving
programme.desc: With only five minutes to play 'Driving', Bluey and Mum race against the clock to buy milk for a grumpy guest and have to escape an angry shopkeeper.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Tina
programme.desc: Tired of being told what to do, Bluey and Bingo enlist their giant invisible friend Tina to show Mum and Dad who's boss. Now they can do anything they want, until Mum and Dad rebel.

programme.desc: The Squirrels are at the Clubhouse playing, but they can't stop thinking about the dreams they had last night. Luckily, Duggee has his dream badge and can help the Squirrels work out what they mean. As the Squirrels think about dreams, all the different dreams of the Clubhouse friends become weirder and more wonderful. We even get to see Duggee's dream!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S04 - The Rainbow Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are out walking around in the rain with Duggee and notice a rainbow! But before they know it, it's gone and the Squirrels are devastated. They decide to make their own rainbow and go off in search of all the colours from everything around them, including strawberries, carrots and bananas. Duggee shows the Squirrels what he has been working on too - a rainbow cake!

programme.title: The Convict Killer
programme.desc: After spending fifteen years in prison on trumped-up charges for drug smuggling, the martial arts master Teng Piao embarks on a journey to take revenge on the person who sets him up - “Black Leopard”. Unfortunately for Piao, no one knows the real identity of “Black Leopard”, except that there is a black leopard tattoo on his chest.

programme.title: The Pearl Phoenix
programme.desc: In Huangmei Opera tradition, this movie tells the love story of Wen, who sells himself as a slave to a rich family, and Huo, the family's young daughter. The lovers are kept apart by Huo's stepmother and Huo escapes by dressing up as a man. Wen is framed and put into jail so Huo has to go back and rescue her lover!

programme.title: The Bells of Death
programme.desc: Wei Fu is an unremarkable woodcutter. However, when psychotic marauders killed his family and abducted his sister, he goes through vigorous martial arts training with an expert swordsman in order to exact revenge on the evildoers.

programme.title: The Sword Stained with Royal Blood
programme.desc: Adapted from Jin Yong's novel, the movie depicts the havoc breaking out in the martial arts world when a warrior on the run uncovers a sword, a training manual, a treasure map and a secret message on the body of a deceased martial arts master.

programme.title: Reincarnated Swordsman
programme.desc: A Wu Dang disciple Fu, kills the chief of Wu Dang Clan and frames it on the chief's illegitimate child, Yun. Fu then proclaims himself the new chief and orders the killing of Yun, who vows to avenge his father's death and learns the invincible silkworm martial arts style in order to defeat Fu.

programme.title: Return of the Sentimental Swordsman
programme.desc: One of Shaw Studio's highest grossing movies ever, this is the story of Li Chin Huan, the renowned, charming and sentimental swordsman who must fight many opponents, including an evil Clan Chief, for a place in the martial arts world.

programme.title: Mr. Funnybone Strikes Again
programme.desc: In this hilarious sequel, Mr Big Potato opens an old-fashioned Chinese clinic, but his traditional methods are rejected by the sceptics of modern Hong Kong. Enter his buddy Mr Funny bone to rescue his business!

programme.title: Lady Of Steel
programme.desc: A young swordswoman Fang Ying Qi sets out to join the Flying Dragon Clan in their defense against the invading Jin forces. Fang also intends to avenge the murder of her parents by bandit leader Han 20 years ago. Han has since taken on a false identity as a member of the Flying Dragon Clan and Fang must rely on her deadly sword skills to stop Han.

programme.title: Madam White Snake
programme.desc: Linda Lin Dai is perfect as Pak Su-cheng, the stunning snake goddess who assumes a womanly form so that she can taste the pleasures of a human life! Pak seduces young scholar, Hsu Hsien when she recognises him as her saviour in another life 1,000 years ago. But when Buddhist monk Fa Hai finds out about the union, the pair is forced to split...

programme.title: Twelve Deadly Coins
programme.desc: When Qiao Miao is about to kill the bandit whom he just met, he is attracted by her beauty and they quickly fall in love. The two later discover the blood feud between the owner of the unique weapon - “Twelve Deadly Coins” and the old master who controls the bandit...

programme.title: Love Parade
programme.desc: Fashion designer Shi asks his friend Mui to comment on his new design but is angered by her criticism. When Mui asks him to design a gown for her to attend a gala event, Shi takes revenge by making a clown costume instead. Seeing Mui's embarrassment, Shi feels guilty and apologizes to her, before they fall in love…

programme.title: The Swordmates
programme.desc: Li asks his swordmate Wang to protect his family while he is away, but Wang rapes his wife and even has his convoy attacked. Li escaped but fears his daughter is still in danger, so he asks the nephew of his master to help protect her…

programme.title: Moonlight Serenade
programme.desc: A sweet inn-keeper's daughter is witness to a perverted rape, leading to more danger than most romantic dramas can handle. Can her true love rescue her in time? For this movie, the moonlight serenade is the sound of suspense, leading to more danger than most romantic dramas can handle.

programme.title: Killers Five
programme.desc: The Duke's daughter has been kidnapped by the notorious Golden Dragon Hill bandits. A swordman named Yue Zhen Bei is assigned to save her, and expecting many dangers on the journey, Yue garners help from a group of good friends who are also kung fu masters.

programme.title: Dawn will Come
programme.desc: Liang Cai drugged the beautiful Qiu Rong and raped her, but promised to marry her after getting his parent's consent. Since then, there is no news of his proposal and Qiu Rong confronts Liang Cai when she finds herself pregnant. This is when she discovers that he has already married a rich noble girl and even plans to kill her…

programme.title: Dawn will Come
programme.desc: Liang Cai drugged the beautiful Qiu Rong and raped her, but promised to marry her after getting his parent's consent. Since then, there is no news of his proposal and Qiu Rong confronts Liang Cai when she finds herself pregnant. This is when she discovers that he has already married a rich noble girl and even plans to kill her…

programme.title: Call to Arms
programme.desc: The aggressive and dangerous Chin Empire conquers the hard-put Chao kingdom while the Wei empire is drained of its heroes and paralyzed by an indecisive ruler. Adventure, intrigue, death and tragedy reigns before the triumphant clash of the armies.

programme.title: Asia-pol
programme.desc: Asiapol agent Yang Ming Xuan trails a shipment of contraband gold being delivered to gang leader, George Eaton. He enlists the help of a Chinese woman who is trying to avenge her sister and narrowly escapes several deadly traps as he closes in on Eaton's location. This spy film is loosely inspired by the James Bond movies.

programme.title: The Three Smiles
programme.desc: A talented scholar, Bo Hu, is attracted by the pretty maid, Qiu Xiang. In order to get close to her and win her love, he disguises as a servant to work in the same household. Qiu Xiang does not believe Bo Hu when he discloses his true identity to her, only falling in love with him when he reveals his talents and with his friends' help.

programme.title: The Love Eterne
programme.desc: Ying Tai disguises herself as a boy to attend school and falls in love with her classmate, Shan Bo. After discovering her true identity, Shan Bo proposes marriage, only to learn that Ying Tai has been promised to another man. Forced apart, Shan Bo dies in despair. Devastated by the news, Ying Tai kills herself at his grave.

programme.title: The Black Enforcer
programme.desc: Lung the Black Enforcer is ordered to escort a murderer Fei to prison. While taking shelter in Lung's house from the snowstorm, Fei is rescued by his gang and Fei kills Lung's mother and sister before escaping. Lung is imprisoned for the failed task and after being released, he vows to avenge his family by killing Fei.

programme.title: The Magnificent Concubine
programme.desc: Yang Gui Fei is the beloved concubine of Emperor Tang Ming Huang, who is so besotted with her that he leaves the running of the country to Prime Minister Yang Guo Zhong, the brother of Yang Gui Fei. The Prime Minister is corrupt and cruel to the army, causing them to revolt and endanger the throne. Yang Gui Fei is also implicated and kills herself.

programme.title: The Lizard
programme.desc: A seasoned burglar 'The Lizard' sets himself up against a corrupt police chief and announced that he will steal a diamond from a rich man's party. His real identity, which is discovered by the corrupt police chief's granddaughter, is actually a young policeman who is doing it all for justice.

programme.title: Apartment for Ladies
programme.desc: A Taiwanese singer comes to Hong Kong in search for her missing younger sister, who had arrived in Hong Kong to be discovered as a nightclub singer. She finds lodging at an apartment for women run by a man-hating landlady, Mrs Chan. However, Mrs Chan cannot confine the young ladies' youthful vitality within the apartment.

programme.title: Temple Of The Red Lotus
programme.desc: A young guy Wu, heads off to the Dragon Valley to meet his childhood friend Lian Chu, who was promised to be his bride. When he arrives, he finds out that the family of his bride may not be an entirely honest bunch of people. Wu wishes to take Lian Chu with him, so he has no choice but to fight against her family…

programme.title: The Butterfly Chalice
programme.desc: In the Ming Dynasty, scholar Tian Yu Chuan defends a fisherman's honour but accidentally kills the governor's son, driving him into exile. Pursued to the river's edge, he is rescued by the fisherman's daughter. Amid danger, love blossoms between them, and Tian seals their bond with his family heirloom, the Butterfly Chalice.

programme.title: Death Valley
programme.desc: When Jianying discovers the Zhao clan's fortune will be left to his brother Yulong, he engineers his parents' death and sends his own son out to kill Yulong.

programme.title: A Place to Call Home
programme.desc: Li Ching, star of Sweet is Revenge, plays one of three daughters, whose life is turned upside down when she discovers she is adopted. But things get even worse when she goes in search of her real mother. Finally, after what is almost a double tragedy, she realizes what so many knew all along: There's no place like home.

programme.title: Bat Without Wings
programme.desc: The Bat Without Wings, a notorious rapist-murderer, has returned after a five-year absence. A young swordsman and a convoy master investigate the case and suspect that the Bat may be framed. A saying goes that a treasure map is hidden under the Bat's knife, so they try to use that to hunt the real culprit…

programme.title: The Pure and the Evil
programme.desc: Two teen girls, Rose and May, become close friends despite their different social backgrounds. The rich girl May moves to America but returns years later to see Rose, now a beauty queen and bar girl. Rose is immediately attracted to Fang's fiancé and their relationship quickly deteriorates when Rose sets out to pursue him…

programme.title: The Pure and the Evil
programme.desc: Two teen girls, Rose and May, become close friends despite their different social backgrounds. The rich girl May moves to America but returns years later to see Rose, now a beauty queen and bar girl. Rose is immediately attracted to Fang's fiancé and their relationship quickly deteriorates when Rose sets out to pursue him…

programme.title: Disciples Of Shaolin
programme.desc: Yi is a skilled disciple of the Hong Quan style kung fu who work in a textile mill recommended by his senior, Han. Han warns Yi not to show off his martial arts skill so as to avoid getting into trouble. However, Yi does not listen and eventually gets dangerously involved in the conflict between two opposing textile mills.

programme.title: Between Tears and Smiles
programme.desc: Fan Jia Shu is a kind-hearted student who is smitten with Shen, a heart-rending love song singer. However, he is not the only one who has eyes for Shen. The General's henchmen are also determined to present the songstress to their superior as a gift. Fan receives help from an unexpected person just in time to save the woman he loves.

programme.title: Invincible Enforcer
programme.desc: A young man is at the wrong place at the wrong time. As he offends a police inspector, he is thrown into jail and even when released, the police goes after him until he has no choice but to become a real criminal. Only a kind and beautiful probation officer is on his side, but can she help him?

programme.title: A Friend from Inner Space
programme.desc: A young boy whose parents are separated tries to find happiness in life. One day, he meets and befriends a kind-hearted spirit Ren, who decides to make him truly happy by getting his parents back together.

programme.title: Ambush
programme.desc: Constable Wen Chao Fan and his father are framed for a jewel robbery they did not commit. On the run from the law and becoming a wanted fugitive, Wen must recover the jewels in order to clear his family name, but unfortunately he is not the only one seeking the stolen jewels...

programme.title: My Dream Boat
programme.desc: This is a story about the complicated love relationships between a group of young friends who are entangled in a web of love and emotions.

programme.title: The Blood Brothers
programme.desc: The friendship of three sworn brothers, Zhang, Huang and Ma ends when Ma gives in to corruption and falls for Huang's wife, eventually leading to a bloody ending.

programme.title: The Story of Sue San
programme.desc: TIn this Huangmei Opera romance, Wang is the son of a respected government official whereas Sue San is a famous prostitute. Although they love each other and seem to be perfectly matched, the two are worlds apart when it comes to social ranking, which will prove hard to overcome...

programme.title: Four Riders
programme.desc: Four martial arts experts live in Seoul after the Korean War in the 1950s. One of them inexplicably crosses path with a drug trafficking syndicate, and his three friends have no choice but to fight a brutal battle on his side...

programme.title: Sunset
programme.desc: Teenage heart-throbs Ching Li and Paul Chin Pei come across like Annette Funicello and Frankie Avalon in the musical Sunset, a musical romp that plays similar to one of Hollywood's famous "Beach Party" movies. A car load of girls meets a car load of boys, and Ching and Paul ultimately fall in love. Yet the film takes an acrid twist and turns out to be more like a Shakespearian tragedy than a beach-babe party.

programme.title: Purple Darts
programme.desc: A girl vows to take revenge for her parents who were murdered by four outlaws when she was only a baby. To do so, she trains hard at martial arts and teams up with a swordsman and a couple to finally kill them all.

programme.title: The Adulteress
programme.desc: The film is about the drugged, then disgraced wife of a peddler in the waning days of the Ching Dynasty. To make matters worse, she's soon framed for her husband's murder by her rapist, the son of the local magistrate! And even that is not the end of her woes in this emotional suspense…

programme.title: King Gambler
programme.desc: This film was actually a lively forerunner to the gambling film craze, which eventually swept Asian cinema. Here, it's cardsharp versus cardsharp with a lot more kung-fu action, in a battle of wits and fists to become the king of the casino. The double stings and triple crosses raise in complexity and imagination until what started as an unusual box office risk became a top ten hit of 1976.

programme.title: Feng Qiao Jing Shi - EP9
programme.desc: CCTV brings you broadcasts of finely-produced artistic dramas that closely follow the pulse of the times.

programme.title: The Accidental Spy
programme.desc: Gifted salesman Siu Buck travels to Turkey to uncover his roots, only to find himself entangled in his spy father's dangerous legacy. Caught in an international conspiracy involving a lethal bioterror threat, he is thrust into a high-stakes chase. As danger closes in, Buck must push beyond his limits to stop a global crisis.

programme.title: Teenage Dreamers
programme.desc: Ting Ting is a student in an all-girl high school. She tries out for the school’s stage production of Romeo and Juliet with an all-boy school and promptly falls for the lead, Jackson. While Ting Ting is swept away by the excitement of her first love, Jackson turns out to be more of a player than a partner.

programme.title: Initial D
programme.desc: The movie is adapted from a famous Japanese manga. 18-year-old Takumi delivers tofu in his father's near-obsolete car every day and becomes a good racer with perfect drifting skill. Encouraged by his father, he joins a mountain race and unexpectedly wins it, making him famous overnight and leading him from one exciting race to another.

programme.title: The Magnificent Scoundrels
programme.desc: Conman Sing is forced by a loan shark to team up with another con artist Betty to steal from a luxurious house. When they encounter other conmen who disguise themselves as the house owners to steal the antiques, they pretend to be their rich guests. As both sides know the other’s true identity, they join forces to con the loan shark into a trap.

programme.title: Mid-night Two
programme.desc: Yi Cheng and his friends venture into a haunted mountain that hides an ancient corpse and an eternal ghostly flame. No one who enters the mountain ever returns and at 2:30 AM, Yi Cheng’s friends vanish one by one. While searching for them in the eerie forest, Yi Cheng enters a realm of infinite reincarnation, facing a series of terrifying events…

programme.title: The Last Tycoon
programme.desc: Gangster Chen Da Qi rises to the upper echelons of power, but finds himself torn between the love of two women, the murderous plots of the secret service, and the looming threat of war.

programme.title: Chinese Odyssey1-Pandora's box
programme.desc: Joker, a carefree bandit leader, learns he is the reincarnation of the Monkey King. As demons and immortals close in, he is drawn into a chaotic, time-bending journey with the mystical Pandora’s Box. Caught between past and present, he must choose between destiny and freedom.

programme.title: Maybe It's Love
programme.desc: A girl Marble witnesses a murder case and reports it to the police. After much investigation, the police can only sort out the complicated relationships between a rich merchant's mistress, a postman, a shop owner and his wife, but find no clue as to who the murderer is. Therefore, Marble decides to carry out her own investigation…

programme.title: Seoul Raiders
programme.desc: A special agent from the Japanese National Security teams up with a skilled thief to find a pair of plates used to make counterfeit USD. However, a US Embassy representative appears and steals the plates, running away to Korea with them.

programme.title: Mr Vampire II
programme.desc: Grave-robbing archaeologists unearth a family of preserved vampires and plan to sell them on the black market. However, they accidentally break the paper spells that had kept the vampires immobilized during transport. The vampires escape, but a local herbalist Lin is soon on their trail, determined to destroy them.

programme.title: Song of the Assassins
programme.desc: A young assassin is assigned his first mission while secretly investigating the cause of his family’s massacre years ago. During the mission, he finds himself entangled in a political conspiracy that has been planned for years and must use his skills as an assassin to face whatever comes his way.

programme.title: Hong Kong Playboys
programme.desc: Sheng is a rich playboy who lives a carefree and fun life with the ladies, until his mother decides that he should get married. Up against other lady killers in his quest to find Miss Right, Sheng must decide what he wants.

programme.title: A Man Called Hero
programme.desc: In 1913, a brutal massacre forces Hua into exile in America. Reunited with his pregnant wife, tragedy strikes again when their home burns down on the night she gives birth to twins, killing her while their daughter gets kidnapped. Sixteen years later, as his son finds him, Hua confronts his ultimate nemesis in a climactic duel on top of the Statue of Liberty.

programme.title: Painted Faces
programme.desc: This is based on the real-life story of Master Yu Jim Yuen who strives to run his academy in the 1960s, even as the opera culture is declining. Three young men, Sammo Hung, Jackie Chan and Yuen Biao, are determined to train under Master Yu and undergo extremely tough training before they become three of Hong Kong’s biggest stars

programme.title: Ip Man 2
programme.desc: After the Sino-Japanese war, Wing Chun grandmaster Ip Man and his family experience hardship in their hometown and eventually moved to Hong Kong for a new life. He wants to open a martial arts school in Hong Kong, but first he must pass and win the challenges put forth by the local martial arts grandmasters.

programme.title: Ip Man 2
programme.desc: After the Sino-Japanese war, Wing Chun grandmaster Ip Man and his family experience hardship in their hometown and eventually moved to Hong Kong for a new life. He wants to open a martial arts school in Hong Kong, but first he must pass and win the challenges put forth by the local martial arts grandmasters.

programme.title: How to Choose a Royal Bride
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager has arranged for a Minister’s daughter Qiong Yao, to become Emperor Kangxi's concubine. However, Qiong Yao escapes in pursuit of freedom in marriage and Kangxi is happy to not go through with the union. When Kangxi travels incognito to Jiangnan, he serendipitously encounters Qiong Yao, who disguises herself as a man…

programme.title: Fate Jealous Greed
programme.desc: The film consists of three short horror stories: a man tries to survive after he received a haunted mail predicting his death; while a man mourns the death of his beloved wife, she becomes a ghost and tries to communicate with him; three brothers clash over the care options of their elderly mother during dinner, leading to a terrifying murder.

programme.title: The Bare-footed Kid
programme.desc: A poor, bare-footed young man from the countryside arrives in the city to work with the friend of his dead father. When their dye shop is burnt down by a local strongman, he decides to fight back to protect all of them and save the shop.

programme.title: Kungfu Stuntmen
programme.desc: Hong Kong action cinema is famous for its real kung fu moves performed by a group called “Kung Fu Stuntmen”. This docu-film pays tribute to the generations of kung fu stuntmen, with the crew spending over two years digging archives and interviewing many talents, including the most prominent masters like Jackie Chan, Donnie Yen and Sammo Hung.

programme.title: Get in the Dark
programme.desc: A reporter hears three horror stories when investigating a case of the paper doll spirit 20 years ago. Miss Qiao had died in vain then, and her butler paid a paper craftsman to make a paper doll to be buried with her. Miss Qiao’s spirit is revived to take revenge when the doll’s eyes are drawn, and a series of horrible events begins to happen...

programme.title: Nezha
programme.desc: A former top team racing driver wants to prove himself in a race but accidentally hurts his teammate Lily, leading to the team’s downfall. When an inexperienced virtual car racing champion joins the team and unexpectedly shines in a real-life race, can the three drivers team up to regain glory for their team?

programme.title: Fierce Cop
programme.desc: To save his son who has been kidnapped by human traffickers, police officer Zhang relentlessly hunts them down and accidentally finds himself implicated in a major child abduction case. In the process, he teams up with a mysterious lady to crack the international crime syndicate and rescue his son.

programme.title: Girl with the Diamond Slipper
programme.desc: An aspiring TV actress gets into hot water when a stolen diamond is hidden in the shoes she bought for a party.

programme.title: Dragon Master: Dragon Spell
programme.desc: The Dragon King is locked in a seal by the Dragon Master for 500 years, and his daughter must travel back in time to 500 years ago to kill the Dragon Master, in order to reverse the act. Little did she know that the Dragon King and Dragon Master were close friends back then…

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh II
programme.desc: Bodyguard Ah Sun is sent to protect his boss' son, only to meet and fall in love with his mistress, the gorgeous Joey. As love blossoms between the two, the powerful boss finds out and all hell breaks loose!

programme.title: Munitions Hijacking Case
programme.desc: Agent Wen is assigned to work undercover for a Southeast Asian arms dealer to locate and destroy a cache of munitions. However, when he finally finds them, he is attacked by unknown gangsters and must team up with his partner to recover the weapons and prevent a disaster.

programme.title: Law Or Justice
programme.desc: Lawyer Yip defends a rapist and gets him acquitted. Yip’s boyfriend Fong, a police inspector, knows he is guilty and despises Yip for not upholding justice. The victim’s sister takes revenge by spiking the rapist’s drink but is raped instead. This puts the rapist back in court. Will Yip choose to uphold law or justice this time?

programme.title: Legend Of The Dragon
programme.desc: A young man Lung leaves his rural home on a small island to seek fortune in Hong Kong. His uncle cons Lung to play in a snooker tournament using his father’s land as the bet. Lung lost the match but luckily, his childhood friend Momo encourages him to compete again using her land as the bet. Can he finally win his land back?

programme.title: Unbeatable
programme.desc: Former world champion boxer Fai meets fiery young fighter Qi in Macau. As he mentors Qi for an upcoming MMA tournament, Fai rekindles his passion for fighting, life, and the people he cares about.

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh
programme.desc: When a young housewife’s debt-ridden, philandering husband leaves her with a mountain of tax debts, a security guard is hired by the tax authority to guard the assets, but he starts falling for her instead.

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh
programme.desc: When a young housewife’s debt-ridden, philandering husband leaves her with a mountain of tax debts, a security guard is hired by the tax authority to guard the assets, but he starts falling for her instead.

programme.title: Lost Memories
programme.desc: As a young mother grapples with her daughter's mysterious disappearance, a series of eerie events unfold. These events could be linked to the vengeful ghosts of a tragic accident that happened 20 years ago...

programme.title: The Gangster, the Cop, the Devil
programme.desc: Detective Lin forms a special task force to crack down on violent motorbike robbers terrorising Foshan and expose the syndicate behind them. However, when his pregnant wife becomes a victim during a brutal attack, Lin uncovers a ruthless conspiracy driven by revenge, pushing him into a dangerous battle against criminals with nothing to lose.

programme.title: Doubles Cause Troubles
programme.desc: Two squabbling cousins find themselves in more trouble than they can imagine after their tenant ends up dead. The gangsters and the police are both after them, and they have no idea what they have done wrong!

programme.title: Paper Man
programme.desc: As the police investigate a gang murder case, another mysterious paper man murder occurs, and the suspects are killed one by one. Continuing to track the clues of the case, the police finally unveil a hidden secret and tragedy spanning two generations.

programme.title: Blind War
programme.desc: Former SWAT captain Dong Gu suffers traumatic visual loss during a failed mission for which he is forced to take responsibility. He manages to get over and adapt to the situation with his daughter’s company, until his nemesis appears and puts his daughter in danger. Despite being blind, Dong Gu must fight to save his daughter.

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: A heroic tale about Hong Kong's brave firefighters. These courageous men can march into disastrous firegrounds and risk their lives to save others. However, do they have the same courage to confront their personal issues?

programme.title: Love Punch
programme.desc: Talented boxer Jia Yang is caught in an underground fight to clear her father's debts. She loses her Olympic aspiration and vanishes from the boxing world. 10 years later, Coach Li Yue is determined to help her honour her father's wish by returning to the ring. As passion and obligation collide, can Jia Yang revive her abandoned boxing dream?

programme.title: Mr. Possessed
programme.desc: Riley is cursed by an evil spirit to not be able to approach any woman. When he falls in love with Siu Yu, Riley’s mother decides to use her to help him vanquish the evil spirit. On their wedding night, Riley passes out after protecting Siu Yu from the attack of the evil spirit. Can the two finally break the curse?

programme.title: 36 Secrets of Courtship
programme.desc: This erotic comedy features three lotharios who vie to become principal of the Macho Man Training School -- an extremely sexy institution dedicated to extremely non Shaolin-types of physical exertion.

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: Ma Wing Jing and his brother arrive in Shanghai to make their fortune. Befriending a powerful mobster Tam, Ma is given his nightclub when he saves Tam’s life. Ma’s fortune rises but he must overcome the corruption and violence to survive.

programme.title: Mother VS Mother
programme.desc: Guan De Xing fell in love with Li Xiao Yun when he was young, but was opposed by his mother and had to marry Zhou Shen Yu. Since then, Li holds a grudge against Zhou. Unfortunately, the son of Guan and Zhou falls in love with Li’s daughter, and as the two mothers meet, they start brawling again!

programme.title: Casino Tycoon
programme.desc: Inspired by the story of Macau’s Casino King Stanley Ho, the movie traces his blood-splattered fight to the top from 1930s to 1960s. In 1941, a young graduate, Benny Ho, flees Hong Kong during the Japanese invasion and heads for Macau. Benny starts as a labourer but rises to the top of the city’s casino business with his courage, wisdom and diligence.

programme.title: The Great Magician
programme.desc: Warlord Lui Dai Ngau commands a powerful army but fails to win the heart of Lau Yiu, whom he keeps in his mansion against her will. Meanwhile, renowned magician Cheung Yin arrives to perform for Lui, while secretly plotting to rescue Lau Yiu and avenge the tragedy that destroyed his family years ago.

programme.title: Fight Back to School II
programme.desc: Following his demotion, officer Sing resigns from the police force and goes undercover at an international school to privately investigate a terrorist plot. There, he discovers bumbling detective Tat posing as a teacher. Forced into an alliance, they team up to confront the heavily armed criminals behind the plot in a chaotic showdown.
